Private Function modCleanupLauncher_Code() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Const SUITE_VERSION As String = ""0.9.3-beta-vba-final""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public gRibbon As Object   ' IRibbonUI -- stored for optional Invalidate calls" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Sub ShowCleanupSuiteLauncher()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    frmCleanupSuiteLauncher.Show" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub RibbonOnLoad(ribbon As Object)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set gRibbon = ribbon" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub AutoExec()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ScheduleCleanupSuiteUpdateCheck" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub AutoOpen()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ' Fires whenever any document is opened while this template is active." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ' Detects an interrupted cleanup operation and warns the user." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim cp As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set cp = ActiveDocument.CustomDocumentProperties(""CleanupSuiteInProgress"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not cp Is Nothing Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim toolName As String: toolName = cp.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim msg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        msg = ""A Cleanup Suite operation ("" & toolName & "") on this document was interrupted unexpectedly."" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        msg = msg & ""The document may be in a partially modified state."" & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        msg = msg & ""If you saved a backup before running cleanup, compare it with this version."" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        msg = msg & ""Press Ctrl+Z to undo any unwanted changes.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox msg, vbExclamation, ""Cleanup Suite - Interrupted Operation""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        cp.Delete" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub AutoClose()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RestoreCleanupSuiteTransientState" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub AutoExit()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RestoreCleanupSuiteTransientState" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    modCleanupLauncher_Code = s
End Function

Private Function modUpdateChecker_Code() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Const UPDATE_SETTINGS_APP As String = ""CleanupSuiteForWord""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Const UPDATE_SETTINGS_SECTION As String = ""GlobalDefaults""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Const UPDATE_ENABLED_SETTING As String = ""UpdateChecks""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Const UPDATE_LAST_CHECK_SETTING As String = ""UpdateLastCheck""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Const UPDATE_INTERVAL_DAYS As Long = 7" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Const UPDATE_MANIFEST_URL As String = ""https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MasseysLab/CleanupSuiteForWord/main/release/latest-release.ini""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Const UPDATE_ALLOWED_URL_PREFIX As String = ""https://github.com/MasseysLab/CleanupSuiteForWord/""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private mUpdateCheckScheduled As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Function GetCleanupSuiteUpdateChecksEnabled() As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim settingText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo UseDefault" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    settingText = GetSetting(UPDATE_SETTINGS_APP, UPDATE_SETTINGS_SECTION, UPDATE_ENABLED_SETTING, ""True"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    GetCleanupSuiteUpdateChecksEnabled = (StrComp(Trim$(settingText), ""True"", vbTextCompare) = 0)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "UseDefault:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    GetCleanupSuiteUpdateChecksEnabled = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub SetCleanupSuiteUpdateChecksEnabled(ByVal enabled As Boolean)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    SaveSetting UPDATE_SETTINGS_APP, UPDATE_SETTINGS_SECTION, UPDATE_ENABLED_SETTING, IIf(enabled, ""True"", ""False"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub ExplainCleanupSuiteUpdateChecksDisabled()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox ""Periodic update checks are now off."" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "           ""To turn them back on, open CleanupSuite and select:"" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "           ""Check periodically for updates."" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "           ""You can still choose Check for Updates at any time."", _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "           vbInformation, ""CleanupSuite Updates""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub ScheduleCleanupSuiteUpdateCheck()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo ScheduleDone" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If mUpdateCheckScheduled Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GetCleanupSuiteUpdateChecksEnabled() Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not CleanupSuiteUpdateCheckIsDue() Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    mUpdateCheckScheduled = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.OnTime When:=Now + TimeValue(""00:00:08""), _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                       Name:=""CheckCleanupSuiteUpdateIfDue"", _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                       Tolerance:=30" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "ScheduleDone:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub CheckCleanupSuiteUpdateIfDue()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    mUpdateCheckScheduled = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GetCleanupSuiteUpdateChecksEnabled() Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not CleanupSuiteUpdateCheckIsDue() Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    CheckForCleanupSuiteUpdates False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub CheckForCleanupSuiteUpdates(Optional ByVal manualCheck As Boolean = True)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim manifestText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim remoteVersion As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim setupUrl As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim releaseUrl As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim messageText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo CheckFailed" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    SaveCleanupSuiteUpdateAttemptTime" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    manifestText = DownloadCleanupSuiteUpdateManifest()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    remoteVersion = ManifestValue(manifestText, ""version"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    setupUrl = ManifestValue(manifestText, ""setup_url"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    releaseUrl = ManifestValue(manifestText, ""release_url"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Len(remoteVersion) = 0 Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1700, ""CheckForCleanupSuiteUpdates"", ""The update manifest did not include a version.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If CompareCleanupSuiteVersions(remoteVersion, SUITE_VERSION) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        messageText = ""CleanupSuite "" & remoteVersion & "" is available."" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                      ""Installed version: "" & SUITE_VERSION & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                      ""Open the newest per-user installer now?""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If MsgBox(messageText, vbInformation + vbYesNo, ""CleanupSuite Update Available"") = vbYes Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If CleanupSuiteUpdateUrlIsAllowed(setupUrl) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                OpenCleanupSuiteUpdateUrl setupUrl" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ElseIf CleanupSuiteUpdateUrlIsAllowed(releaseUrl) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                OpenCleanupSuiteUpdateUrl releaseUrl" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1701, ""CheckForCleanupSuiteUpdates"", ""The update link was not from the CleanupSuite repository.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ElseIf manualCheck Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""CleanupSuite is current on the stable release channel."" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "               ""Installed version: "" & SUITE_VERSION, _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "               vbInformation, ""CleanupSuite Updates""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "CheckFailed:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If manualCheck Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""CleanupSuite could not check for updates right now."" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "               ""Your installed version was not changed."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "               ""Try Check for Updates again later."", vbExclamation, ""CleanupSuite Updates""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function CleanupSuiteUpdateCheckIsDue() As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim savedValue As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim lastCheckValue As Double" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo CheckNow" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    savedValue = GetSetting(UPDATE_SETTINGS_APP, UPDATE_SETTINGS_SECTION, UPDATE_LAST_CHECK_SETTING, """")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Len(Trim$(savedValue)) = 0 Then GoTo CheckNow" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    lastCheckValue = CDbl(savedValue)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    CleanupSuiteUpdateCheckIsDue = (DateDiff(""d"", CDate(lastCheckValue), Now) >= UPDATE_INTERVAL_DAYS)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "CheckNow:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    CleanupSuiteUpdateCheckIsDue = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub SaveCleanupSuiteUpdateAttemptTime()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    SaveSetting UPDATE_SETTINGS_APP, UPDATE_SETTINGS_SECTION, UPDATE_LAST_CHECK_SETTING, CStr(CDbl(Now))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function DownloadCleanupSuiteUpdateManifest() As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim request As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set request = CreateObject(""MSXML2.ServerXMLHTTP.6.0"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    request.setTimeouts 3000, 3000, 5000, 5000" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    request.Open ""GET"", UPDATE_MANIFEST_URL, False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    request.setRequestHeader ""User-Agent"", ""CleanupSuiteForWord/"" & SUITE_VERSION" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    request.Send" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If CLng(request.Status) <> 200 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1702, ""DownloadCleanupSuiteUpdateManifest"", ""HTTP status "" & CStr(request.Status)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    DownloadCleanupSuiteUpdateManifest = CStr(request.responseText)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function ManifestValue(ByVal manifestText As String, ByVal keyName As String) As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim lines As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim lineValue As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim equalsAt As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim currentKey As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    lines = Split(Replace$(manifestText, vbCr, vbNullString), vbLf)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each lineValue In lines" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If Len(Trim$(CStr(lineValue))) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Left$(Trim$(CStr(lineValue)), 1) <> ""#"" Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                equalsAt = InStr(CStr(lineValue), ""="")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If equalsAt > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    currentKey = Trim$(Left$(CStr(lineValue), equalsAt - 1))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If StrComp(currentKey, keyName, vbTextCompare) = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        ManifestValue = Trim$(Mid$(CStr(lineValue), equalsAt + 1))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next lineValue" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function CleanupSuiteUpdateUrlIsAllowed(ByVal urlValue As String) As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    CleanupSuiteUpdateUrlIsAllowed = (StrComp(Left$(urlValue, Len(UPDATE_ALLOWED_URL_PREFIX)), _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                                               UPDATE_ALLOWED_URL_PREFIX, vbTextCompare) = 0)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub OpenCleanupSuiteUpdateUrl(ByVal urlValue As String)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim shellObject As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set shellObject = CreateObject(""WScript.Shell"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    shellObject.Run Chr$(34) & urlValue & Chr$(34), 1, False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function CompareCleanupSuiteVersions(ByVal leftVersion As String, ByVal rightVersion As String) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim leftCore As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim rightCore As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim leftValue As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim rightValue As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim leftRank As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim rightRank As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    leftCore = Split(CleanupVersionCore(leftVersion), ""."")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    rightCore = Split(CleanupVersionCore(rightVersion), ""."")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = 0 To 2" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        leftValue = CleanupVersionNumberAt(leftCore, i)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        rightValue = CleanupVersionNumberAt(rightCore, i)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If leftValue > rightValue Then CompareCleanupSuiteVersions = 1: Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If leftValue < rightValue Then CompareCleanupSuiteVersions = -1: Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    leftRank = CleanupPrereleaseRank(leftVersion)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    rightRank = CleanupPrereleaseRank(rightVersion)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If leftRank > rightRank Then CompareCleanupSuiteVersions = 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If leftRank < rightRank Then CompareCleanupSuiteVersions = -1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function CleanupVersionCore(ByVal versionText As String) As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim normalized As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    normalized = LCase$(Trim$(versionText))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Left$(normalized, 1) = ""v"" Then normalized = Mid$(normalized, 2)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If InStr(normalized, ""-"") > 0 Then normalized = Left$(normalized, InStr(normalized, ""-"") - 1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    CleanupVersionCore = normalized" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function CleanupVersionNumberAt(ByVal versionParts As Variant, ByVal indexValue As Long) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo MissingValue" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If indexValue <= UBound(versionParts) Then CleanupVersionNumberAt = CLng(Val(CStr(versionParts(indexValue))))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "MissingValue:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    CleanupVersionNumberAt = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function CleanupPrereleaseRank(ByVal versionText As String) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim normalized As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    normalized = LCase$(Trim$(versionText))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If InStr(normalized, ""-"") = 0 Then CleanupPrereleaseRank = 40: Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If InStr(normalized, ""rc"") > 0 Then CleanupPrereleaseRank = 30: Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If InStr(normalized, ""beta"") > 0 Then CleanupPrereleaseRank = 20: Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If InStr(normalized, ""alpha"") > 0 Then CleanupPrereleaseRank = 10: Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    CleanupPrereleaseRank = 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    modUpdateChecker_Code = s
End Function

    s = s & "                normalCount = normalCount + 1" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "Public Sub RefreshMetadataDashboardQuickScan(ByVal frm As Object)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim filePath As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    filePath = ResolvePreferredDocxTarget(vbNullString, False)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Len(filePath) = 0 And Len(mDashboardTargetPath) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If FileExists(mDashboardTargetPath) And IsSupportedDocxPath(mDashboardTargetPath) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            filePath = mDashboardTargetPath" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Len(filePath) = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        mDashboardTargetPath = vbNullString" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ResetDashboardState" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        UpdateDashboardDisplay frm" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    Dim payload As String" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    pairs = Split(payload, "";"")" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "        Case ""yes/no"": SafeCustomTypeCode = MSO_PROPERTY_TYPE_BOOLEAN" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    End Select" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    Select Case SafeCustomTypeCode(typeName)" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "Private Function ValidateSafeCustomProperty(ByVal propertyName As String, ByVal typeName As String, _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                                            ByVal valueText As String, ByRef validationMessage As String) As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Len(propertyName) = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        validationMessage = ""Enter a custom property name.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Len(propertyName) > 255 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        validationMessage = ""Custom property names cannot exceed 255 characters.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Select Case SafeCustomTypeCode(typeName)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Case MSO_PROPERTY_TYPE_NUMBER" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Not IsNumeric(valueText) Or CDbl(valueText) <> Fix(CDbl(valueText)) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                validationMessage = ""Enter a whole number for a Number property.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Case MSO_PROPERTY_TYPE_FLOAT" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Not IsNumeric(valueText) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                validationMessage = ""Enter a numeric value for a Decimal property.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Case MSO_PROPERTY_TYPE_BOOLEAN" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Select Case LCase$(Trim$(valueText))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Case ""true"", ""false"", ""yes"", ""no"", ""1"", ""0""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Case Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    validationMessage = ""Enter Yes, No, True, False, 1, or 0 for a Yes/No property.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End Select" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Case MSO_PROPERTY_TYPE_DATE" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Not IsDate(valueText) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                validationMessage = ""Enter a recognizable date for a Date property.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End Select" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ValidateSafeCustomProperty = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub SaveSafeMetadataEditor(ByVal frm As Object)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim validationMessage As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errorText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim rowIsValid As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If mSafeEditDocument Is Nothing Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""The document for safe metadata editing is no longer available."", _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "               vbExclamation, ""Safe Metadata Editor""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = 0 To frm.lstCustomProperties.ListCount - 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        rowIsValid = ValidateSafeCustomProperty(CStr(frm.lstCustomProperties.List(i, 0)), _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                                                CStr(frm.lstCustomProperties.List(i, 1)), _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                                                CStr(frm.lstCustomProperties.List(i, 2)), validationMessage)" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "Private Sub ApplySafeCustomPropertyChanges(ByVal frm As Object, ByRef errorText As String)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim prop As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim propertyIndex As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalName As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalType As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim currentType As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim typedValue As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For propertyIndex = mSafeEditDocument.CustomDocumentProperties.Count To 1 Step -1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set prop = mSafeEditDocument.CustomDocumentProperties(propertyIndex)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If SafeCustomPropertyIsEditable(prop) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Not SafeCustomOriginalNameIsListed(frm, CStr(prop.Name)) Then prop.Delete" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Err.Clear" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next propertyIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = 0 To frm.lstCustomProperties.ListCount - 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        originalName = CStr(frm.lstCustomProperties.List(i, 3))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        originalType = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If Len(CStr(frm.lstCustomProperties.List(i, 4))) > 0 Then _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            originalType = CLng(frm.lstCustomProperties.List(i, 4))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        currentType = SafeCustomTypeCode(CStr(frm.lstCustomProperties.List(i, 1)))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        typedValue = SafeCustomTypedValue(CStr(frm.lstCustomProperties.List(i, 1)), _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                                          CStr(frm.lstCustomProperties.List(i, 2)))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Err.Clear" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If Len(originalName) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If StrComp(originalName, CStr(frm.lstCustomProperties.List(i, 0)), vbTextCompare) = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If originalType = currentType Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    mSafeEditDocument.CustomDocumentProperties(originalName).Value = typedValue" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    mSafeEditDocument.CustomDocumentProperties(originalName).Delete" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Err.Clear" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    mSafeEditDocument.CustomDocumentProperties.Add _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        Name:=CStr(frm.lstCustomProperties.List(i, 0)), _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        LinkToContent:=False, Type:=currentType, Value:=typedValue" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                mSafeEditDocument.CustomDocumentProperties(originalName).Delete" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Err.Clear" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                mSafeEditDocument.CustomDocumentProperties.Add _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Name:=CStr(frm.lstCustomProperties.List(i, 0)), _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    LinkToContent:=False, Type:=currentType, Value:=typedValue" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            mSafeEditDocument.CustomDocumentProperties.Add _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Name:=CStr(frm.lstCustomProperties.List(i, 0)), _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                LinkToContent:=False, Type:=currentType, Value:=typedValue" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If Err.Number <> 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            errorText = errorText & ""- Custom property "" & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        CStr(frm.lstCustomProperties.List(i, 0)) & "" ("" & Err.Number & ""): "" & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        Err.Description & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Err.Clear" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    Dim prop As Object" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "Private Function PromptAndUpdateCustomProperties(ByVal path As String) As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim inputText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim pairs() As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim pair() As String" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    Dim node As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim nodes As Object" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    inputText = InputBox(""Enter custom metadata as name=value pairs separated by semicolons."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    If Len(Trim$(inputText)) = 0 Then" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    If xmlDoc.parseError.ErrorCode <> 0 Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "        pair = Split(Trim$(pairs(i)), ""="", 2)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If UBound(pair) >= 1 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            namePart = Trim$(pair(0))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            valuePart = Trim$(pair(1))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Len(namePart) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Set nodes = xmlDoc.SelectNodes(""//*[local-name()='property']"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                For Each node In nodes" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If LCase$(node.getAttribute(""name"")) = LCase$(namePart) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        node.Text = valuePart" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        updated = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        Exit For" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Next node" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If Not updated Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Dim newNode As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Set newNode = xmlDoc.createElement(""property"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    newNode.setAttribute ""name"", namePart" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    newNode.Text = valuePart" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    xmlDoc.documentElement.appendChild newNode" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    updated = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If updated Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        xmlDoc.Save path" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        PromptAndUpdateCustomProperties = True" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "        partData = ReadTextFile(xmlFile)" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "            ScanXmlMetadata xmlFile, xmlText, report.XmlFindings" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ScanCryptoText xmlFile, xmlText, report.CryptoFindings" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ScanGuessing xmlFile, xmlText, report.GuessFindings" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    ' Embedded/nested files" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    AddEmbeddedFileFindings tempDir, report.EmbeddedFiles" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ' Cleanup temp folder (best effort)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    DeleteFolder tempDir" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    AuditDocx = report" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    Dim filePath As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doc As Object" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    previewText = BuildSharingPropertiesPreview(doc)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If InStr(1, previewText, ""No populated sharing properties"", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox previewText, vbInformation, ""Clear Sharing Properties""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        GoTo ClearExit" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "                 ""CleanupSuite-managed custom properties will be restored afterward."" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                 ""Continue?""" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    doc.Save" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox ""Sharing properties were cleared."", vbInformation, ""Clear Sharing Properties""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not frm Is Nothing Then RefreshMetadataDashboardQuickScan frm" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "ClearErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox ""Unable to clear sharing properties: "" & Err.Description, vbExclamation, ""Clear Sharing Properties""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Resume ClearExit" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function BuildSharingPropertiesPreview(ByVal doc As Object) As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim fields As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim fieldName As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim valueText As String" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    pathEnd = Len(rawText) + 1" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "        Select Case Mid$(rawText, scanPos, 1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Case "" "", "")"", ""]""" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    Next scanPos" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "        ReplaceAuditTempPathSegment = rawText" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "Private Function BuildAuthorMetadataRemovalPreview(ByVal filePath As String, ByVal removalLevel As String) As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doc As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim closeWhenDone As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim fields As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim valueText As String" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    Dim prop As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim count As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    If doc Is Nothing Then" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "        If Len(valueText) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            sb = sb & ""[Will clear] Built-in property: "" & CStr(fields(i)) & "" | "" & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                 VisualizeHiddenCharacters(valueText) & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            count = count + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each prop In doc.CustomDocumentProperties" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If ShouldClearCustomAuthorProperty(prop.Name, removalLevel) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            valueText = CStr(prop.Value)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Err.Number <> 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Err.Clear" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                valueText = """"" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            sb = sb & ""[Will clear] Custom property: "" & CStr(prop.Name) & "" | "" & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                 VisualizeHiddenCharacters(valueText) & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            count = count + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next prop" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    Const PERSONAL_URL_PREFIX As String = ""https://d.docs.live.net/""" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "Private Sub ScanXmlMetadata(ByVal filePath As String, ByVal xmlText As String, ByRef outColl As Collection)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim lineText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim lines() As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim regex As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim matches As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim m As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim lineNo As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim foundText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set regex = CreateObject(""VBScript.RegExp"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    regex.Global = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    regex.IgnoreCase = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    regex.Pattern = META_WORDS & ""|"" & GUID_PATTERN & ""|"" & URL_PATTERN & ""|"" & DATE_PATTERN" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    lines = Split(xmlText, vbNewLine)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = LBound(lines) To UBound(lines)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        lineText = Trim$(lines(i))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If Len(lineText) = 0 Then GoTo NextLine" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If ShouldSkipSuiteManagedMetadataLine(filePath, lineText) Then GoTo NextLine" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        lineNo = i + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If LooksLikeMetadataText(lineText) Or regex.Test(lineText) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set matches = regex.Execute(lineText)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If matches.Count > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                For Each m In matches" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    foundText = m.value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If Len(foundText) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        outColl.Add ""Part: "" & filePath & "" (line "" & CStr(lineNo) & "") -> "" & foundText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Next m" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                outColl.Add ""Part: "" & filePath & "" (line "" & CStr(lineNo) & "") -> "" & lineText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    NextLine:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function LooksLikeMetadataText(ByVal text As String) As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim lowerText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    lowerText = LCase$(text)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LooksLikeMetadataText = _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""author"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""creator"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""modified"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""created"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""revision"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""template"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""comment"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""company"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""title"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""subject"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""keyword"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""user"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""owner"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""guid"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""uuid"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""url"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""path"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""mailto"") > 0 Or _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        InStr(lowerText, ""rsid"") > 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub ScanCryptoText(ByVal filePath As String, ByVal text As String, ByRef outColl As Collection)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim regex As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim matches As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim m As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim candidate As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ShouldSkipSuiteManagedMetadataLine(filePath, text) Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set regex = CreateObject(""VBScript.RegExp"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    regex.Global = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    regex.IgnoreCase = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    regex.Pattern = HASH_PATTERN_LIST" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set matches = regex.Execute(text)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each m In matches" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        candidate = m.value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        outColl.Add ""CRY | Hash-like pattern in "" & filePath & "": "" & candidate" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next m" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ' Additional crypto / encoding indicators" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If InStr(text, ""Salted__"") > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        outColl.Add ""CRY | OpenSSL Salt marker in "" & filePath" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If InStr(text, ""PK"") > 0 And InStr(text, Chr$(3)) > 0 And InStr(text, Chr$(4)) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        outColl.Add ""CRY | ZIP/container signature in "" & filePath" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If RegexContains(text, GUID_PATTERN) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        outColl.Add ""CRY | GUID-like identifier in "" & filePath" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If RegexContains(text, URL_PATTERN) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        outColl.Add ""REL | URL-like reference in "" & filePath" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If LooksLikeBase64(text) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        outColl.Add ""ENC | Base64-like segment in "" & filePath" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If RegexContains(text, HEX_PATTERN) And Len(text) > 64 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        outColl.Add ""ENC | Large hex-like segment in "" & filePath" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function LooksLikeBase64(ByVal text As String) As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim regex As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set regex = CreateObject(""VBScript.RegExp"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    regex.Pattern = BASE64_PATTERN" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    regex.Global = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    regex.IgnoreCase = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LooksLikeBase64 = regex.Test(Replace$(text, vbCrLf, """"))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function RegexContains(ByVal text As String, ByVal pattern As String) As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim regex As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set regex = CreateObject(""VBScript.RegExp"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    regex.Global = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    regex.IgnoreCase = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    regex.Pattern = pattern" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RegexContains = regex.Test(text)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub ScanGuessing(ByVal filePath As String, ByVal text As String, ByRef outColl As Collection)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim fieldWords As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim lowText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ShouldSkipSuiteManagedMetadataLine(filePath, text) Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    lowText = LCase$(text)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    fieldWords = Array(""author"", ""creator"", ""document"", ""subject"", ""title"", ""comments"", ""template"", ""manager"", ""company"", ""owner"", ""password"", ""secret"", _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                      ""key"", ""token"", ""uuid"", ""guid"", ""revision"", ""last"", ""modified"", ""created"", ""user"", ""email"", ""path"", ""url"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = LBound(fieldWords) To UBound(fieldWords)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If InStr(lowText, fieldWords(i)) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            outColl.Add ""GES | Guessing hint in "" & filePath & "" -> "" & CStr(fieldWords(i))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub AddEmbeddedFileFindings(ByVal rootFolder As String, ByRef outColl As Collection)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim fso As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim folder As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim file As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim subFolder As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim extensionName As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set fso = CreateObject(""Scripting.FileSystemObject"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set folder = fso.GetFolder(rootFolder)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each file In folder.Files" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        extensionName = LCase$(fso.GetExtensionName(file.Path))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Select Case extensionName" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Case ""png"", ""jpg"", ""jpeg"", ""gif"", ""bmp"", ""pdf""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                outColl.Add file.Path" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End Select" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next file" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each subFolder In folder.SubFolders" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddEmbeddedFileFindings subFolder.Path, outColl" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next subFolder" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function BuildReportText(ByRef report As AuditReport) As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim sb As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim item As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    sb = ""DOCX Metadata Audit Report"" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "         ""=========================="" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "         ""File: "" & report.FilePath & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "         ""Extracted root: "" & report.ExtractedRoot & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "         ""Is ZIP/Open XML: "" & IIf(report.IsZip, ""Yes"", ""No"") & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "         ""Status legend:"" & vbCrLf & report.StatusLegend & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "         ""Summary:"" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "         ""- Package parts: "" & CStr(report.PackageParts.Count) & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "         ""- Core props: "" & CStr(report.DocPropsCore.Count) & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "         ""- App props: "" & CStr(report.DocPropsApp.Count) & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "         ""- Custom props: "" & CStr(report.DocPropsCustom.Count) & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "         ""- Relationships: "" & CStr(report.Relationships.Count) & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "         ""- XML findings: "" & CStr(report.XmlFindings.Count) & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "         ""- Crypto findings: "" & CStr(report.CryptoFindings.Count) & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "         ""- Guessing findings: "" & CStr(report.GuessFindings.Count) & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "         ""- Embedded files: "" & CStr(report.EmbeddedFiles.Count) & vbCrLf & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    sb = sb & ""Document properties (core):"" & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If report.DocPropsCore.Count = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        sb = sb & ""- None found"" & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each item In report.DocPropsCore" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            sb = sb & ""- "" & item & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next item" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    sb = sb & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    sb = sb & ""Document properties (app):"" & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If report.DocPropsApp.Count = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        sb = sb & ""- None found"" & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each item In report.DocPropsApp" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            sb = sb & ""- "" & item & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next item" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    sb = sb & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    sb = sb & ""Document properties (custom):"" & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If report.DocPropsCustom.Count = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        sb = sb & ""- None found"" & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each item In report.DocPropsCustom" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            sb = sb & ""- "" & item & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next item" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    sb = sb & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    sb = sb & ""Relationships:"" & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If report.Relationships.Count = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        sb = sb & ""- None found"" & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each item In report.Relationships" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            sb = sb & ""- "" & item & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next item" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    sb = sb & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    sb = sb & ""XML metadata findings:"" & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If report.XmlFindings.Count = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        sb = sb & ""- None found"" & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each item In report.XmlFindings" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            sb = sb & ""- "" & item & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next item" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    sb = sb & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    sb = sb & ""Cryptography / encoding findings:"" & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If report.CryptoFindings.Count = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        sb = sb & ""- None found"" & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "            sb = sb & ""- "" & item & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next item" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    sb = sb & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    sb = sb & ""Guessing findings:"" & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If report.GuessFindings.Count = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        sb = sb & ""- None found"" & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each item In report.GuessFindings" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            sb = sb & ""- "" & item & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next item" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    sb = sb & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    If report.EmbeddedFiles.Count = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        sb = sb & ""- None found"" & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each item In report.EmbeddedFiles" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            sb = sb & ""- "" & item & vbCrLf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next item" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    BuildReportText = sb" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function IIf(ByVal condition As Boolean, ByVal trueVal As Variant, ByVal falseVal As Variant) As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If condition Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        IIf = trueVal" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        IIf = falseVal" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function GetAllFiles(ByVal rootFolder As String) As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim fso As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim folder As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim file As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim result As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set result = New Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set fso = CreateObject(""Scripting.FileSystemObject"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set folder = fso.GetFolder(rootFolder)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each file In folder.Files" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        result.Add file.Path" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next file" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each folder In folder.SubFolders" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim nested As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set nested = GetAllFiles(folder.Path)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim v As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each v In nested" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            result.Add v" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next v" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next folder" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set GetAllFiles = result" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    modMetaDataSuite_Code = s
End Function

' ---------------------------
' Full UserForm code strings (injected into each form)
' Note: these code strings assume the named controls exist on the form.
' If programmatic control creation fails, follow the manual checklist to add controls.
' ---------------------------

' Punctuation cleanup (full implementation)
Private Function frmPunctuationCleanup_Code() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ReturnToMainAfterToolClose Me, Cancel, CloseMode" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Punctuation Normalizer" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Replaces typographic / smart punctuation characters with plain-text" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  equivalents: curly double and single quotes, em and en dashes, and" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  the ellipsis character.  Essential before importing text into systems" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  that do not handle Unicode punctuation." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optAll.GroupName = ""PunctMode""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optQuotes.GroupName = ""PunctMode""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optDashes.GroupName = ""PunctMode""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optEllipses.GroupName = ""PunctMode""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optCustom.GroupName = ""PunctMode""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.GroupName = ""PunctScope""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeSelection.GroupName = ""PunctScope""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optAll.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UpdateCustomVisibility" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ClearCustomChecks" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Caption = ""Entire document""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeSelection.Caption = ""Selected text only""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RefreshScopeSelectionState Me, True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optAll.Caption = ""All punctuation types""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optQuotes.Caption = ""Quotes only""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optDashes.Caption = ""Dashes only""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optEllipses.Caption = ""Ellipses only""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optCustom.Caption = ""Custom""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkCurlyDouble.Caption = ""Curly double quotes  -> straight double quotes""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkCurlySingle.Caption = ""Curly single quotes / apostrophes  -> straight single quotes""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkEmDash.Caption = ""Em dash  ->  hyphen-minus  -""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkEnDash.Caption = ""En dash  ->  hyphen-minus  -""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkEllipses.Caption = ""Ellipsis character  ->  three dots  ...""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Caption = ""Preview only (highlight, do not change)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutPunctuationForm" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub LayoutPunctuationForm()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutCleanupToolForm Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UpdateCustomVisibility()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    fraCustom.Visible = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optAll_Click(): UpdateCustomVisibility: LayoutPunctuationForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optQuotes_Click(): UpdateCustomVisibility: LayoutPunctuationForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optDashes_Click(): UpdateCustomVisibility: LayoutPunctuationForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optEllipses_Click(): UpdateCustomVisibility: LayoutPunctuationForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optCustom_Click(): UpdateCustomVisibility: LayoutPunctuationForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementPunctuationAll_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""All punctuation types"", ""Text caution"", ""Changes visible punctuation characters across quotes, dashes, and ellipses. Preview first for prose where typography matters."": End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementPunctuationQuotes_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Quotes only"", ""Text caution"", ""Converts curly quotes and apostrophes to straight plain-text marks."": End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementPunctuationDashes_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Dashes only"", ""Text caution"", ""Converts em and en dashes to plain hyphens, which changes visible punctuation style."": End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementPunctuationEllipses_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Ellipses only"", ""Text caution"", ""Converts the single ellipsis character to three plain periods."": End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementPunctuationCustom_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Custom punctuation cleanup"", ""Inspect first"", ""Lets you combine individual punctuation conversions. Preview first when preserving typography may matter."": End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub ClearCustomChecks()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkCurlyDouble.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkCurlySingle.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkEmDash.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkEnDash.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkEllipses.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdSelectAll_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optCustom.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UpdateCustomVisibility" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkCurlyDouble.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkCurlySingle.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkEmDash.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkEnDash.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkEllipses.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutPunctuationForm" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdDeselectAll_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optCustom.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UpdateCustomVisibility" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ClearCustomChecks" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutPunctuationForm" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkCurlyDouble_Click(): LayoutPunctuationForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkCurlySingle_Click(): LayoutPunctuationForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkEmDash_Click(): LayoutPunctuationForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkEnDash_Click(): LayoutPunctuationForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkEllipses_Click(): LayoutPunctuationForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdPreview_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    PreviewFromPanel" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub PreviewFromPanel()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    BeginPreviewActionIndicator Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    EndPreviewActionIndicator" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdReset_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UserForm_Initialize" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub RunAfterPreview()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRun_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ActiveDocument.ProtectionType <> wdNoProtection Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""This document is protected. Please remove protection before running cleanup."", vbExclamation, ""Document Protected"": Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GuardBeforeCleanup(""Punctuation Normalizer"") Then Unload Me: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim findList As Collection, replaceList As Collection, itemLabels As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim idx As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewOnly As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim screenUpdatingWasOn As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim autoFormatAsYouTypeQuotesWasOn As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim autoFormatQuotesWasOn As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    previewOnly = chkPreviewOnly.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    screenUpdatingWasOn = Application.ScreenUpdating" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim targetRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optScopeSelection.Value And optScopeSelection.Enabled Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = GetTargetRange()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = ActiveDocument.Content" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim includeCurlyDouble As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim includeCurlySingle As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim includeEmDash As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim includeEnDash As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim includeEllipses As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    includeCurlyDouble = optAll.Value Or optQuotes.Value Or (optCustom.Value And chkCurlyDouble.Value)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    includeCurlySingle = optAll.Value Or optQuotes.Value Or (optCustom.Value And chkCurlySingle.Value)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    includeEmDash = optAll.Value Or optDashes.Value Or (optCustom.Value And chkEmDash.Value)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    includeEnDash = optAll.Value Or optDashes.Value Or (optCustom.Value And chkEnDash.Value)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    includeEllipses = optAll.Value Or optEllipses.Value Or (optCustom.Value And chkEllipses.Value)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set findList = New Collection: Set replaceList = New Collection: Set itemLabels = New Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optAll.Value Or optQuotes.Value Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        findList.Add ChrW(&H201C): replaceList.Add """"""""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        itemLabels.Add ""Left curly double quotes (U+201C)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        findList.Add ChrW(&H201D): replaceList.Add """"""""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        itemLabels.Add ""Right curly double quotes (U+201D)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        findList.Add ChrW(&H2018): replaceList.Add ""'""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        itemLabels.Add ""Left curly single quotes (U+2018)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        findList.Add ChrW(&H2019): replaceList.Add ""'""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        itemLabels.Add ""Right curly single quotes / apostrophes (U+2019)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optAll.Value Or optDashes.Value Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        findList.Add ChrW(&H2014): replaceList.Add ""-"" : itemLabels.Add ""Em dashes (U+2014)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        findList.Add ChrW(&H2013): replaceList.Add ""-"" : itemLabels.Add ""En dashes (U+2013)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optAll.Value Or optEllipses.Value Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        findList.Add ChrW(&H2026): replaceList.Add ""..."" : itemLabels.Add ""Ellipses (U+2026)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optCustom.Value Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set findList = New Collection: Set replaceList = New Collection: Set itemLabels = New Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If chkCurlyDouble.Value Then findList.Add ChrW(&H201C): replaceList.Add """""""" : itemLabels.Add ""Left curly double quotes (U+201C)"" : findList.Add ChrW(&H201D): replaceList.Add """""""" : itemLabels.Add ""Right curly double quotes (U+201D)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If chkCurlySingle.Value Then findList.Add ChrW(&H2018): replaceList.Add ""'"" : itemLabels.Add ""Left curly single quotes (U+2018)"" : findList.Add ChrW(&H2019): replaceList.Add ""'"" : itemLabels.Add ""Right curly single quotes / apostrophes (U+2019)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If chkEmDash.Value Then findList.Add ChrW(&H2014): replaceList.Add ""-"" : itemLabels.Add ""Em dashes (U+2014)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If chkEnDash.Value Then findList.Add ChrW(&H2013): replaceList.Add ""-"" : itemLabels.Add ""En dashes (U+2013)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If chkEllipses.Value Then findList.Add ChrW(&H2026): replaceList.Add ""..."" : itemLabels.Add ""Ellipses (U+2026)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If findList.Count = 0 Then MsgBox ""No punctuation options selected."", vbInformation: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If previewOnly Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        On Error GoTo PreviewErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRows As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewCurlyDouble As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewCurlySingle As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewEmDash As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewEnDash As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewEllipses As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If includeCurlyDouble Then previewCurlyDouble = CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, ChrW(&H201C), True) + CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, ChrW(&H201D), True)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If includeCurlySingle Then previewCurlySingle = CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, ChrW(&H2018), True) + CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, ChrW(&H2019), True)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If includeEmDash Then previewEmDash = CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, ChrW(&H2014), True)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If includeEnDash Then previewEnDash = CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, ChrW(&H2013), True)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If includeEllipses Then previewEllipses = CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, ChrW(&H2026), True)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewCharacters As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For idx = 1 To findList.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            previewCharacters = previewCharacters & CStr(findList(idx))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next idx" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        HighlightPreviewFindCharacters targetRange, previewCharacters" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set previewRows = NewPreviewSummaryRows()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Curly double quotes"", previewCurlyDouble, False, (Not includeCurlyDouble)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Curly single quotes"", previewCurlySingle, False, (Not includeCurlySingle)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Em dashes"", previewEmDash, False, (Not includeEmDash)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""En dashes"", previewEnDash, False, (Not includeEnDash)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Ellipses"", previewEllipses, False, (Not includeEllipses)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ShowPreviewActionsSummary Me, ""Punctuation Normalizer"", previewRows" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""Punctuation Normalizer""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - Punctuation Normalizer""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    autoFormatAsYouTypeQuotesWasOn = Options.AutoFormatAsYouTypeReplaceQuotes" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    autoFormatQuotesWasOn = Options.AutoFormatReplaceQuotes" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Options.AutoFormatAsYouTypeReplaceQuotes = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Options.AutoFormatReplaceQuotes = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.ScreenUpdating = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ' Replace each conversion family in one bulk pass." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If includeCurlyDouble Then ReplacePunctuationCharacterSet targetRange, ChrW(&H201C) & ChrW(&H201D), """"""""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If includeCurlySingle Then ReplacePunctuationCharacterSet targetRange, ChrW(&H2018) & ChrW(&H2019), ""'""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim dashCharacters As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If includeEmDash Then dashCharacters = dashCharacters & ChrW(&H2014)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If includeEnDash Then dashCharacters = dashCharacters & ChrW(&H2013)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Len(dashCharacters) > 0 Then ReplacePunctuationCharacterSet targetRange, dashCharacters, ""-""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If includeEllipses Then ReplacePunctuationCharacterSet targetRange, ChrW(&H2026), ""...""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.ScreenUpdating = screenUpdatingWasOn" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Options.AutoFormatAsYouTypeReplaceQuotes = autoFormatAsYouTypeQuotesWasOn" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Options.AutoFormatReplaceQuotes = autoFormatQuotesWasOn" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ' Remove highlighting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RemoveAllHighlighting targetRange" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "PreviewErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.ScreenUpdating = screenUpdatingWasOn" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox ""Could not build the punctuation preview: "" & Err.Description, vbExclamation, ""Punctuation Preview""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.ScreenUpdating = screenUpdatingWasOn" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Options.AutoFormatAsYouTypeReplaceQuotes = autoFormatAsYouTypeQuotesWasOn" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Options.AutoFormatReplaceQuotes = autoFormatQuotesWasOn" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next: undoRec.EndCustomRecord: On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function ReplacePunctuationCharacterSet(ByVal searchRange As Range, ByVal findCharacters As String, ByVal replacementText As String) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim replaceRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim characterIndex As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For characterIndex = 1 To Len(findCharacters)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ReplacePunctuationCharacterSet = ReplacePunctuationCharacterSet + CountPreviewFindMatches(searchRange, Mid$(findCharacters, characterIndex, 1))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next characterIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ReplacePunctuationCharacterSet = 0 Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set replaceRange = searchRange.Duplicate" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    With replaceRange.Find" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .ClearFormatting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Replacement.ClearFormatting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Text = ""["" & findCharacters & ""]""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Replacement.Text = replacementText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Forward = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Wrap = wdFindStop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Format = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .MatchWildcards = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End With" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmPunctuationCleanup_Code = s
End Function
