    s = s & "    UpdateCustomVisibility" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkNBSP.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkZWSP.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkZWNJ.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkZWJ.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkBOM.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkSoftHyphen.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkNBHyphen.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutUnicodeForm" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdDeselectAll_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optCustom.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UpdateCustomVisibility" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ClearCustomChecks" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutUnicodeForm" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function UnicodeChar(ByVal codePoint As Long) As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If codePoint > &H7FFF Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        UnicodeChar = ChrW$(codePoint - &H10000)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        UnicodeChar = ChrW$(codePoint)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkNBSP_Click(): LayoutUnicodeForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkZWSP_Click(): LayoutUnicodeForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkZWNJ_Click(): LayoutUnicodeForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkZWJ_Click(): LayoutUnicodeForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkBOM_Click(): LayoutUnicodeForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkSoftHyphen_Click(): LayoutUnicodeForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkNBHyphen_Click(): LayoutUnicodeForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdPreview_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    PreviewFromPanel" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub PreviewFromPanel()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    BeginPreviewActionIndicator Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    EndPreviewActionIndicator" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdReset_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UserForm_Initialize" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub RunAfterPreview()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRun_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ActiveDocument.ProtectionType <> wdNoProtection Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""This document is protected. Please remove protection before running cleanup."", vbExclamation, ""Document Protected"": Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GuardBeforeCleanup(""Unicode Cleaner"") Then Unload Me: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim findList As Collection, replaceList As Collection, itemLabels As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim counts() As Long, idx As Long, i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewOnly As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    previewOnly = chkPreviewOnly.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim targetRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optScopeSelection.Value And optScopeSelection.Enabled Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = GetTargetRange()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = ActiveDocument.Content" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set findList = New Collection: Set replaceList = New Collection: Set itemLabels = New Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optAll.Value Or optNBSP.Value Then findList.Add UnicodeChar(&HA0): replaceList.Add "" "" : itemLabels.Add ""Non-breaking spaces (U+00A0)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optAll.Value Or optZeroWidth.Value Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        findList.Add UnicodeChar(&H200B): replaceList.Add """" : itemLabels.Add ""Zero-width spaces (U+200B)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        findList.Add UnicodeChar(&H200C): replaceList.Add """" : itemLabels.Add ""Zero-width non-joiners (U+200C)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        findList.Add UnicodeChar(&H200D): replaceList.Add """" : itemLabels.Add ""Zero-width joiners (U+200D)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        findList.Add UnicodeChar(&HFEFF): replaceList.Add """" : itemLabels.Add ""BOM / zero-width no-break spaces (U+FEFF)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optAll.Value Then findList.Add UnicodeChar(&HAD): replaceList.Add ""-"" : itemLabels.Add ""Soft hyphens (U+00AD)"" : findList.Add UnicodeChar(&H2011): replaceList.Add ""-"" : itemLabels.Add ""Non-breaking hyphens (U+2011)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optCustom.Value Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set findList = New Collection: Set replaceList = New Collection: Set itemLabels = New Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If chkNBSP.Value Then findList.Add UnicodeChar(&HA0): replaceList.Add "" "" : itemLabels.Add ""Non-breaking spaces (U+00A0)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If chkZWSP.Value Then findList.Add UnicodeChar(&H200B): replaceList.Add """" : itemLabels.Add ""Zero-width spaces (U+200B)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If chkZWNJ.Value Then findList.Add UnicodeChar(&H200C): replaceList.Add """" : itemLabels.Add ""Zero-width non-joiners (U+200C)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If chkZWJ.Value Then findList.Add UnicodeChar(&H200D): replaceList.Add """" : itemLabels.Add ""Zero-width joiners (U+200D)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If chkBOM.Value Then findList.Add UnicodeChar(&HFEFF): replaceList.Add """" : itemLabels.Add ""BOM / zero-width no-break spaces (U+FEFF)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If chkSoftHyphen.Value Then findList.Add UnicodeChar(&HAD): replaceList.Add ""-"" : itemLabels.Add ""Soft hyphens (U+00AD)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If chkNBHyphen.Value Then findList.Add UnicodeChar(&H2011): replaceList.Add ""-"" : itemLabels.Add ""Non-breaking hyphens (U+2011)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If findList.Count = 0 Then MsgBox ""No Unicode options selected."", vbInformation: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ReDim counts(1 To findList.Count): For i = 1 To findList.Count: counts(i) = 0: Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If previewOnly Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRows As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewNBSP As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewZWSP As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewZWNJ As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewZWJ As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewBOM As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewSoftHyphen As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewNBHyphen As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim includeNBSP As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim includeZWSP As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim includeZWNJ As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim includeZWJ As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim includeBOM As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim includeSoftHyphen As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim includeNBHyphen As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        includeNBSP = optAll.Value Or optNBSP.Value Or (optCustom.Value And chkNBSP.Value)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        includeZWSP = optAll.Value Or optZeroWidth.Value Or (optCustom.Value And chkZWSP.Value)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        includeZWNJ = optAll.Value Or optZeroWidth.Value Or (optCustom.Value And chkZWNJ.Value)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        includeZWJ = optAll.Value Or optZeroWidth.Value Or (optCustom.Value And chkZWJ.Value)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        includeBOM = optAll.Value Or optZeroWidth.Value Or (optCustom.Value And chkBOM.Value)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        includeSoftHyphen = optAll.Value Or (optCustom.Value And chkSoftHyphen.Value)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        includeNBHyphen = optAll.Value Or (optCustom.Value And chkNBHyphen.Value)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If includeNBSP Then previewNBSP = CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, UnicodeChar(&HA0))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If includeZWSP Then previewZWSP = CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, UnicodeChar(&H200B))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If includeZWNJ Then previewZWNJ = CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, UnicodeChar(&H200C))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If includeZWJ Then previewZWJ = CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, UnicodeChar(&H200D))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If includeBOM Then previewBOM = CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, UnicodeChar(&HFEFF))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If includeSoftHyphen Then previewSoftHyphen = CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, UnicodeChar(&HAD))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If includeNBHyphen Then previewNBHyphen = CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, UnicodeChar(&H2011))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For idx = 1 To findList.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            HighlightUnicodeMatches targetRange, CStr(findList(idx)), UnicodePreviewNeedsAdjacentFallback(CStr(findList(idx)))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next idx" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set previewRows = NewPreviewSummaryRows()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Non-breaking spaces"", previewNBSP, False, (Not includeNBSP)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Zero-width spaces"", previewZWSP, False, (Not includeZWSP)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Zero-width non-joiners"", previewZWNJ, False, (Not includeZWNJ)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Zero-width joiners"", previewZWJ, False, (Not includeZWJ)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Byte order marks"", previewBOM, False, (Not includeBOM)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Soft hyphens"", previewSoftHyphen, False, (Not includeSoftHyphen)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Non-breaking hyphens"", previewNBHyphen, False, (Not includeNBHyphen)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ShowPreviewActionsSummary Me, ""Unicode Cleaner"", previewRows" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""Unicode Cleaner""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - Unicode Cleaner""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For idx = 1 To findList.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        counts(idx) = ReplaceUnicodeMatches(targetRange, CStr(findList(idx)), CStr(replaceList(idx)))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next idx" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RemoveAllHighlighting targetRange" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next: undoRec.EndCustomRecord: On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function ReplaceUnicodeMatches(ByVal searchRange As Range, ByVal findText As String, ByVal replacementText As String) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim matchRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set matchRange = searchRange.Duplicate" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    With matchRange.Find" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .ClearFormatting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Replacement.ClearFormatting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Text = findText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Forward = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Wrap = wdFindStop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .MatchWildcards = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Do While .Execute" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            matchRange.Text = replacementText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ReplaceUnicodeMatches = ReplaceUnicodeMatches + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            matchRange.Collapse wdCollapseEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End With" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function UnicodePreviewNeedsAdjacentFallback(ByVal findText As String) As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If findText = UnicodeChar(&H200C) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        UnicodePreviewNeedsAdjacentFallback = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ElseIf Not UnicodeFormattingMarksVisible() Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        UnicodePreviewNeedsAdjacentFallback = (findText = UnicodeChar(&H200B) Or findText = UnicodeChar(&HFEFF))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function UnicodeFormattingMarksVisible() As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UnicodeFormattingMarksVisible = ActiveWindow.View.ShowAll" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub HighlightUnicodeMatches(ByVal searchRange As Range, ByVal findText As String, ByVal useAdjacentFallback As Boolean)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim matchRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim searchEnd As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    searchEnd = searchRange.End" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set matchRange = searchRange.Duplicate" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        With matchRange.Find" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .ClearFormatting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .Text = findText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .Forward = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .Wrap = wdFindStop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .MatchWildcards = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Not .Execute Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End With" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ApplyPreviewHighlight matchRange" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If useAdjacentFallback Then HighlightUnicodeAdjacentCharacter matchRange, searchRange" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        matchRange.Collapse wdCollapseEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If matchRange.Start >= searchEnd Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        matchRange.End = searchEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub HighlightUnicodeAdjacentCharacter(ByVal matchRange As Range, ByVal scopeRange As Range)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim markerRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If matchRange.End < scopeRange.End Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set markerRange = ActiveDocument.Range(matchRange.End, matchRange.End + 1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ElseIf matchRange.Start > scopeRange.Start Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set markerRange = ActiveDocument.Range(matchRange.Start - 1, matchRange.Start)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ApplyPreviewHighlight markerRange" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmUnicodeCleanup_Code = s
End Function

    Dim s As String

    s = s & "Private Sub cmdSelectAll_Click()" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    UpdateCustomVisibility" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkDoubleSpaces.Value = True" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    chkExtraBlankLines.Value = True" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkDoubleSpaces_Click(): LayoutSpacingForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkTrimSpaces_Click(): LayoutSpacingForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkSpaceBeforePunct_Click(): LayoutSpacingForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkNormalizeAfterPunct_Click(): LayoutSpacingForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkExtraBlankLines_Click(): LayoutSpacingForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdPreview_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    PreviewFromPanel" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub PreviewFromPanel()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    BeginPreviewActionIndicator Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    EndPreviewActionIndicator" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdReset_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UserForm_Initialize" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub RunAfterPreview()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRun_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ActiveDocument.ProtectionType <> wdNoProtection Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""This document is protected. Please remove protection before running cleanup."", vbExclamation, ""Document Protected"": Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GuardBeforeCleanup(""Spacing Fixer"") Then Unload Me: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewOnly As Boolean: previewOnly = chkPreviewOnly.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim targetRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optScopeSelection.Value And optScopeSelection.Enabled Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = GetTargetRange()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = ActiveDocument.Content" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doDouble As Boolean, doTrim As Boolean, doBeforePunct As Boolean, doAfterPunct As Boolean, doBlank As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optAll.Value Then doDouble = True: doTrim = True: doBeforePunct = True: doAfterPunct = True: doBlank = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optDoubleSpaces.Value Then doDouble = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optTrim.Value Then doTrim = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optCustom.Value Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        doDouble = chkDoubleSpaces.Value: doTrim = chkTrimSpaces.Value: doBeforePunct = chkSpaceBeforePunct.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        doAfterPunct = chkNormalizeAfterPunct.Value: doBlank = chkExtraBlankLines.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not (doDouble Or doTrim Or doBeforePunct Or doAfterPunct Or doBlank) Then MsgBox ""No spacing options selected."", vbInformation: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If previewOnly Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRows As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewDouble As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewTrim As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewBefore As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewAfter As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewBlank As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewBlankStarts As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewProtectedCells As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewProtectedRows As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewProtectedFinal As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewSkipped As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doDouble Then previewDouble = CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, ""  "")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doTrim Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim previewPara As Paragraph" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For Each previewPara In targetRange.Paragraphs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If ParagraphContainedInRange(previewPara, targetRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Dim previewParagraphText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    previewParagraphText = ParagraphBodyText(previewPara)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If Trim$(previewParagraphText) <> previewParagraphText Then previewTrim = previewTrim + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next previewPara" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doBeforePunct Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            previewBefore = CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, "" ."") + CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, "" ,"") + CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, "" ;"") + CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, "" :"") + CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, "" !"") + CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, "" ?"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doAfterPunct Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            previewAfter = CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, "".  "") + CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, ""?  "") + CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, ""!  "") + CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, "",  "") + CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, "";  "") + CountPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, "":  "")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doBlank Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set previewBlankStarts = CollectCollapsibleBlankParagraphStarts(targetRange, False, previewProtectedCells, previewProtectedRows, previewProtectedFinal, previewSkipped)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            previewBlank = previewBlankStarts.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim previewBlankIndex As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For previewBlankIndex = 1 To previewBlankStarts.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ApplyPreviewMinimalMarker ActiveDocument.Range(previewBlankStarts(previewBlankIndex), previewBlankStarts(previewBlankIndex))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next previewBlankIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ' Highlight preview matches." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doDouble Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Call HighlightPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, ""  "")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doBeforePunct Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim previewBeforePunctPatterns" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim previewBeforePunct" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            previewBeforePunctPatterns = Array("" ."", "" ,"", "" ;"", "" :"", "" !"", "" ?"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For Each previewBeforePunct In previewBeforePunctPatterns" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Call HighlightPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, CStr(previewBeforePunct))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next previewBeforePunct" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doAfterPunct Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim punctPatterns" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim punct" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            punctPatterns = Array("".  "", ""?  "", ""!  "", "",  "", "";  "", "":  "")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For Each punct In punctPatterns" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Call HighlightPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, CStr(punct))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next punct" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doTrim Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Call HighlightPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, ""^p "")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Call HighlightPreviewFindMatches(targetRange, "" ^p"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set previewRows = NewPreviewSummaryRows()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Double spaces"", previewDouble, False, (Not doDouble)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Leading/trailing spaces"", previewTrim, False, (Not doTrim)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Spaces before punctuation"", previewBefore, False, (Not doBeforePunct)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Spaces after punctuation"", previewAfter, False, (Not doAfterPunct)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Extra blank lines"", previewBlank, False, (Not doBlank)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ShowPreviewActionsSummary Me, ""Spacing Fixer"", previewRows" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""Spacing Fixer""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - Spacing Fixer""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ' Perform replacements with counting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim cntDouble As Long, cntTrim As Long, cntBefore As Long, cntAfter As Long, cntBlank As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim replacedThisPass As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doTrim Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim para As Paragraph" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim paraIndex As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim trimParagraphCount As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        trimParagraphCount = targetRange.Paragraphs.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For paraIndex = trimParagraphCount To 1 Step -1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set para = targetRange.Paragraphs(paraIndex)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If ParagraphContainedInRange(para, targetRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim paraText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim trimmedText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                paraText = ParagraphBodyText(para)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                trimmedText = Trim$(paraText)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If trimmedText <> paraText Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    ReplaceParagraphBodyText para, trimmedText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    cntTrim = cntTrim + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next paraIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doBeforePunct Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim beforePunctPatterns: beforePunctPatterns = Array("" ."", "" ,"", "" ;"", "" :"", "" !"", "" ?"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim beforePunct" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each beforePunct In beforePunctPatterns" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            cntBefore = cntBefore + ReplaceSpacingLiteralMatches(targetRange, CStr(beforePunct), Right$(CStr(beforePunct), 1))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next beforePunct" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doAfterPunct Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim applyPunctPatterns: applyPunctPatterns = Array("".  "",""?  "",""!  "","",  "","";  "","":  "")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim pattern" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each pattern In applyPunctPatterns" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                replacedThisPass = ReplaceSpacingLiteralMatches(targetRange, CStr(pattern), Left$(CStr(pattern), 1) & "" "")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                cntAfter = cntAfter + replacedThisPass" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Loop While replacedThisPass > 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next pattern" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doDouble Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            replacedThisPass = ReplaceSpacingLiteralMatches(targetRange, ""  "", "" "")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            cntDouble = cntDouble + replacedThisPass" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Loop While replacedThisPass > 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doBlank Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim blankStarts As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim protectedCells As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim protectedRows As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim protectedFinal As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim skippedStructures As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set blankStarts = CollectCollapsibleBlankParagraphStarts(targetRange, False, protectedCells, protectedRows, protectedFinal, skippedStructures)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim blankIndex As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For blankIndex = blankStarts.Count To 1 Step -1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If RemoveCleanupBlankParagraphAtStart(ActiveDocument, CLng(blankStarts(blankIndex)), cbpkRemovableBody) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                cntBlank = cntBlank + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next blankIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RemoveAllHighlighting ActiveDocument.Content" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next: undoRec.EndCustomRecord: On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function ReplaceSpacingLiteralMatches(ByVal searchRange As Range, ByVal findText As String, ByVal replacementText As String) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim matchRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set matchRange = searchRange.Duplicate" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    With matchRange.Find" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .ClearFormatting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Replacement.ClearFormatting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Text = findText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Forward = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Wrap = wdFindStop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .MatchWildcards = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Do While .Execute" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            matchRange.Text = replacementText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ReplaceSpacingLiteralMatches = ReplaceSpacingLiteralMatches + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            matchRange.Collapse wdCollapseEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End With" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmSpacingCleanup_Code = s
End Function

    s = s & "Private Sub HighlightCapitalizationDifferenceRuns(ByVal p As Paragraph, ByVal originalText As String, ByVal transformedText As String)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim compareLength As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim runStart As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim paragraphStart As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim changedRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    compareLength = Len(originalText)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Len(transformedText) < compareLength Then compareLength = Len(transformedText)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    paragraphStart = p.Range.Start" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    i = 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Do While i <= compareLength" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If Mid$(originalText, i, 1) = Mid$(transformedText, i, 1) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            i = i + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            runStart = i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Do While i <= compareLength" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If Mid$(originalText, i, 1) = Mid$(transformedText, i, 1) Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                i = i + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set changedRange = ActiveDocument.Range(paragraphStart + runStart - 1, paragraphStart + i - 1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ApplyPreviewHighlight changedRange" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Len(originalText) <> Len(transformedText) Then ApplyPreviewHighlight p.Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function SmartRepairParagraph(ByVal textValue As String, ByVal useAbbreviations As Boolean, ByVal protectAcronyms As Boolean, ByVal protectNames As Boolean, ByVal useHeadingHeuristics As Boolean, ByVal titleCaseParentheticalText As Boolean, ByVal useContextRules As Boolean, Optional ByVal styleHeadingLike As Boolean = False) As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Len(Trim$(textValue)) = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        SmartRepairParagraph = textValue" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If headingLike And Not useHeadingHeuristics Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        SmartRepairParagraph = textValue" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim working As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    working = textValue" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If headingLike Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        working = ApplyHeadingCase(working, titleCaseParentheticalText)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        working = NormalizeLongUppercaseWords(working, protectAcronyms, protectNames)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        working = ApplySentenceRepairs(working, useAbbreviations, useContextRules)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    working = RestoreProtectedTerms(working, useAbbreviations, protectAcronyms, protectNames)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If headingLike And Not titleCaseParentheticalText Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        working = RestoreOriginalParentheticalText(textValue, working)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    SmartRepairParagraph = working" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub CountLetterCase(ByVal textValue As String, ByRef lowerCount As Long, ByRef upperCount As Long, ByRef letterCount As Long)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim currentChar As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = 1 To Len(textValue)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        currentChar = Mid$(textValue, i, 1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If currentChar Like ""[A-Za-z]"" Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            letterCount = letterCount + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If currentChar = LCase$(currentChar) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                lowerCount = lowerCount + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                upperCount = upperCount + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function CountWords(ByVal textValue As String) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim inWord As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim currentChar As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = 1 To Len(textValue)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        currentChar = Mid$(textValue, i, 1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If IsTokenWordChar(currentChar) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Not inWord Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                CountWords = CountWords + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                inWord = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            inWord = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function CountHeadingWords(ByVal textValue As String) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim token As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim currentChar As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = 1 To Len(textValue) + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If i <= Len(textValue) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            currentChar = Mid$(textValue, i, 1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            currentChar = "" """ & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If IsTokenWordChar(currentChar) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            token = token & currentChar" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Len(token) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If TokenContainsLetter(token) Then CountHeadingWords = CountHeadingWords + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                token = """"" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "            repairedInnerText = ApplyHeadingCase(innerText, True)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Mid$(resultText, openIndex + 1, Len(innerText)) = repairedInnerText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        openIndex = closeIndex + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Loop" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    ApplyBalancedParentheticalHeadingCase = resultText" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "Private Function IsLikelyHeadingText(ByVal textValue As String) As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim trimmedText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim headingCandidate As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim headingWordCount As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    trimmedText = Trim$(textValue)" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    headingWordCount = CountHeadingWords(headingCandidate)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If headingWordCount = 0 Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If headingWordCount > 10 Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim lowerCount As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim upperCount As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim letterCount As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    CountLetterCase headingCandidate, lowerCount, upperCount, letterCount" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If letterCount = 0 Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If upperCount / letterCount >= 0.65 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        IsLikelyHeadingText = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim titleWords As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim uppercaseWords As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    CountHeadingCaseWords headingCandidate, titleWords, uppercaseWords" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If titleWords >= 2 And titleWords >= headingWordCount - 1 Then IsLikelyHeadingText = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If uppercaseWords >= 2 And titleWords >= 2 And titleWords + uppercaseWords >= headingWordCount - 1 Then IsLikelyHeadingText = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub CountHeadingCaseWords(ByVal textValue As String, ByRef titleWords As Long, ByRef uppercaseWords As Long)" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "            currentChar = Mid$(textValue, i, 1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            currentChar = "" """ & vbCrLf

    s = s & "" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "        ElseIf Len(token) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            lettersOnly = TokenLettersOnly(token)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Len(lettersOnly) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "                    uppercaseWords = uppercaseWords + 1" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            token = """"" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function GetCapitalizationCustomExceptions() As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    InvalidateCapitalizationCache" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    Dim response As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    response = InputBox(""Enter words exactly as you want them capitalized, separated by semicolons."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        ""Example: MetaDataSuite; CleanUpSuite; JW"", _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        ""Capitalization Custom Exceptions"", _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        NormalizeCapitalizationExceptionList(GetCapitalizationCustomExceptions()))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    SetCapitalizationCustomExceptions response" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function NormalizeCapitalizationExceptionList(ByVal exceptionText As String) As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim entries As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim normalizedEntry As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Len(Trim$(exceptionText)) = 0 Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    entries = Split(exceptionText, "";"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = LBound(entries) To UBound(entries)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        normalizedEntry = Trim$(CStr(entries(i)))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If Len(normalizedEntry) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Len(NormalizeCapitalizationExceptionList) > 0 Then _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                NormalizeCapitalizationExceptionList = NormalizeCapitalizationExceptionList & ""; """ & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            NormalizeCapitalizationExceptionList = NormalizeCapitalizationExceptionList & normalizedEntry" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub LoadCapitalizationCustomExceptions(ByVal exceptionText As String)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim entries As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Len(Trim$(exceptionText)) = 0 Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    entries = Split(exceptionText, "";"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = LBound(entries) To UBound(entries)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddCustomCapitalizationException CStr(entries(i))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub AddCustomCapitalizationException(ByVal entryText As String)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim canonicalText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    canonicalText = Trim$(entryText)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Len(canonicalText) = 0 Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    mCapitalizationProtectedTermDict(LCase$(canonicalText)) = canonicalText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If canonicalText = UCase$(canonicalText) And Len(TokenLettersOnly(canonicalText)) > 1 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        mCapitalizationAcronymDict(UCase$(TokenLettersOnly(canonicalText))) = canonicalText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub AddLookupValues(ByVal dict As Object, ByVal values As Variant)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = LBound(values) To UBound(values)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        dict(CStr(values(i))) = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub AddLookupPairs(ByVal dict As Object, ByVal values As Variant)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = LBound(values) To UBound(values)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim parts As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        parts = Split(CStr(values(i)), ""|"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        dict(CStr(parts(0))) = CStr(parts(1))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmCapitalizationCleanup_Code = s
End Function

    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GuardBeforeCleanup(""List Normalizer"") Then Unload Me: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewOnly As Boolean: previewOnly = chkPreviewOnly.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim targetRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optScopeSelection.Value And optScopeSelection.Enabled Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = GetTargetRange()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = ActiveDocument.Content" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    If optAll.Value Then doBullets = True: doNumbering = True: doIndent = True: doHyphen = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optBullets.Value Then doBullets = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optNumbering.Value Then doNumbering = True" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    If Not (doBullets Or doNumbering Or doIndent Or doHyphen) Then MsgBox ""No list options selected."", vbInformation: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "        ' Only typed prefixes can be highlighted. Word-generated markers and" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ' ruler indents are reported in the summary without artificial marks." & vbCrLf

    s = s & "                If actionIndent Then previewIndent = previewIndent + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next p" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "        Dim previewRows As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set previewRows = NewPreviewSummaryRows()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Hyphen list items"", previewHyphen, False, (Not doHyphen)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Bullet list items"", previewBullets, False, (Not doBullets)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Numbered list items"", previewNumbering, False, (Not doNumbering)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""List indents"", previewIndent, False, (Not doIndent)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ShowPreviewActionsSummary Me, ""List Normalizer"", previewRows" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""List Normalizer""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - List Normalizer""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim cntHyphen As Long, cntBullets As Long, cntNumbering As Long, cntIndent As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doBullets   Then cntBullets   = NormalizeBullets(targetRange)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doHyphen    Then cntHyphen    = ConvertHyphenListsToBullets(targetRange)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doNumbering Then cntNumbering = NormalizeNumbering(targetRange)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doIndent    Then cntIndent    = FixListIndentation(targetRange)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RemoveAllHighlighting targetRange" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next: undoRec.EndCustomRecord: On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub HighlightManualListPrefix(ByVal p As Paragraph, ByVal isNumbered As Boolean)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim visibleText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim prefixLength As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    visibleText = ParagraphBodyText(p)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If isNumbered Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        prefixLength = InStr(visibleText, ""."")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If prefixLength > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Do While prefixLength < Len(visibleText)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If Mid$(visibleText, prefixLength + 1, 1) <> "" "" And Mid$(visibleText, prefixLength + 1, 1) <> vbTab Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                prefixLength = prefixLength + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ElseIf Left$(visibleText, 2) = ""- "" Or Left$(visibleText, 2) = ""* "" Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        prefixLength = 2" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If prefixLength > 0 Then ApplyPreviewHighlight ActiveDocument.Range(p.Range.Start, p.Range.Start + prefixLength)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function ConvertHyphenListsToBullets(scopeRange As Range) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim p As Paragraph, listText As String, cnt As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim shadingColor As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each p In scopeRange.Paragraphs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If ParagraphOverlapsRangeOutsideTable(p, scopeRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            listText = Trim$(ParagraphBodyText(p))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Left$(listText, 2) = ""- "" Or Left$(listText, 2) = ""* "" Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                shadingColor = p.Range.Shading.BackgroundPatternColor" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Set p = ReplaceAndRefreshListParagraph(p, Mid$(listText, 3))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ApplyListBulletStyle p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ApplyStandardListIndent p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                TightenListParagraphSpacing p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                RestoreListParagraphShading p, shadingColor" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                cnt = cnt + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ConvertHyphenListsToBullets = cnt" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function NormalizeBullets(scopeRange As Range) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim p As Paragraph, cnt As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each p In scopeRange.Paragraphs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If ParagraphOverlapsRangeOutsideTable(p, scopeRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If p.Range.ListFormat.ListType <> wdListNoNumbering Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If p.Range.ListFormat.ListType = wdListBullet Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    ApplyStandardListIndent p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    TightenListParagraphSpacing p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    cnt = cnt + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    NormalizeBullets = cnt" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub ApplyListBulletStyle(ByVal p As Paragraph)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If p.Range.ListFormat.ListType <> wdListBullet Then p.Range.ListFormat.ApplyBulletDefault" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function NormalizeNumbering(scopeRange As Range) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim p As Paragraph, listText As String, cnt As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim inNumberRun As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim shadingColor As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each p In scopeRange.Paragraphs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If ParagraphOverlapsRangeOutsideTable(p, scopeRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            listText = Trim$(ParagraphBodyText(p))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If IsManualNumberedListText(listText) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim pos As Long: pos = InStr(listText, ""."")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                shadingColor = p.Range.Shading.BackgroundPatternColor" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If pos > 0 Then Set p = ReplaceAndRefreshListParagraph(p, LTrim$(Mid$(listText, pos + 1)))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ApplyListNumberStyle p, inNumberRun" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ApplyStandardListIndent p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                TightenListParagraphSpacing p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                RestoreListParagraphShading p, shadingColor" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                inNumberRun = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                cnt = cnt + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If Len(listText) > 0 Then inNumberRun = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    NormalizeNumbering = cnt" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub ApplyListNumberStyle(ByVal p As Paragraph, ByVal continuePreviousList As Boolean)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    p.Range.ListFormat.ApplyListTemplateWithLevel _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ListTemplate:=ListGalleries(wdNumberGallery).ListTemplates(1), _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ContinuePreviousList:=continuePreviousList, _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ApplyTo:=wdListApplyToWholeList, _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        DefaultListBehavior:=wdWord10ListBehavior" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub ResolveListParagraphActions(ByVal p As Paragraph, ByVal listText As String, ByVal doBullets As Boolean, ByVal doNumbering As Boolean, ByVal doIndent As Boolean, ByVal doHyphen As Boolean, ByRef actionHyphen As Boolean, ByRef actionBullets As Boolean, ByRef actionNumbering As Boolean, ByRef actionIndent As Boolean)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    actionHyphen = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    actionBullets = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    actionNumbering = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    actionIndent = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doHyphen And (Left$(listText, 2) = ""- "" Or Left$(listText, 2) = ""* "") Then actionHyphen = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doNumbering And IsManualNumberedListText(listText) Then actionNumbering = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If actionHyphen Or actionNumbering Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doBullets And p.Range.ListFormat.ListType = wdListBullet Then actionBullets = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doIndent And ListIndentNeedsFix(p) Then actionIndent = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function IsManualNumberedListText(ByVal listText As String) As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim pos As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    pos = InStr(listText, ""."")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If pos <= 1 Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not Left$(listText, pos - 1) Like String$(Len(Left$(listText, pos - 1)), ""#"") Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    IsManualNumberedListText = (Len(Trim$(Mid$(listText, pos + 1))) > 0)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function ReplaceAndRefreshListParagraph(ByVal p As Paragraph, ByVal replacementText As String) As Paragraph" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim paragraphStart As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    paragraphStart = p.Range.Start" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ReplaceParagraphBodyText p, replacementText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set ReplaceAndRefreshListParagraph = ActiveDocument.Range(paragraphStart, paragraphStart).Paragraphs(1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub RestoreListParagraphShading(ByVal p As Paragraph, ByVal shadingColor As Long)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    p.Range.Shading.BackgroundPatternColor = shadingColor" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub ApplyStandardListIndent(ByVal p As Paragraph)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    With p.Range.ParagraphFormat" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .LeftIndent = InchesToPoints(0.5)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .FirstLineIndent = InchesToPoints(-0.25)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End With" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function ListIndentNeedsFix(ByVal p As Paragraph) As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If p.Range.ListFormat.ListType = wdListNoNumbering Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ListIndentNeedsFix = (Abs(p.Range.ParagraphFormat.LeftIndent - InchesToPoints(0.5)) > 0.5 Or Abs(p.Range.ParagraphFormat.FirstLineIndent - InchesToPoints(-0.25)) > 0.5)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub TightenListParagraphSpacing(ByVal p As Paragraph)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    With p.Range.ParagraphFormat" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .SpaceBeforeAuto = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .SpaceAfterAuto = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .SpaceBefore = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .SpaceAfter = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .LineSpacingRule = wdLineSpaceSingle" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End With" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function FixListIndentation(scopeRange As Range) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim p As Paragraph, cnt As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each p In scopeRange.Paragraphs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If ParagraphOverlapsRangeOutsideTable(p, scopeRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If ListIndentNeedsFix(p) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ApplyStandardListIndent p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                TightenListParagraphSpacing p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                cnt = cnt + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    FixListIndentation = cnt" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmListCleanup_Code = s
End Function

    s = s & "    BeginPreviewActionIndicator Me" & vbCrLf
