    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdReset_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UserForm_Initialize" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub RunAfterPreview()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRun_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ActiveDocument.ProtectionType <> wdNoProtection Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""This document is protected. Please remove protection before running cleanup."", vbExclamation, ""Document Protected"": Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GuardBeforeCleanup(""Paragraph Fixer"") Then Unload Me: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewOnly As Boolean: previewOnly = chkPreviewOnly.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim targetRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optScopeSelection.Value And optScopeSelection.Enabled Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = GetTargetRange()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = ActiveDocument.Content" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set targetRange = ParagraphCleanupTargetRange(targetRange)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doRemove As Boolean, doCollapse As Boolean, doNormalize As Boolean, doIndent As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optAll.Value Then doRemove = True: doCollapse = True: doNormalize = True: doIndent = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optRemoveEmpty.Value Then doRemove = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optNormalizeSpacing.Value Then doNormalize = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optCustom.Value Then doRemove = chkRemoveEmpty.Value: doCollapse = chkCollapseBreaks.Value: doNormalize = chkNormalizeParaSpacing.Value: doIndent = chkFixIndent.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not (doRemove Or doCollapse Or doNormalize Or doIndent) Then MsgBox ""No paragraph options selected."", vbInformation: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim p As Paragraph" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim cntRemove As Long, cntCollapse As Long, cntNormalize As Long, cntIndent As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If previewOnly Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doRemove Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim previewBlankStarts As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim previewProtectedCells As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim previewProtectedRows As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim previewProtectedFinal As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim previewSkipped As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set previewBlankStarts = CollectCollapsibleBlankParagraphStarts(targetRange, True, previewProtectedCells, previewProtectedRows, previewProtectedFinal, previewSkipped)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            cntRemove = previewBlankStarts.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim previewBlankIndex As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For previewBlankIndex = 1 To previewBlankStarts.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ApplyPreviewMinimalMarker ActiveDocument.Range(previewBlankStarts(previewBlankIndex), previewBlankStarts(previewBlankIndex))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next previewBlankIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doCollapse Then cntCollapse = HighlightPreviewFindBoundaryMatches(targetRange, ""^l"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doNormalize Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For Each p In targetRange.Paragraphs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If ParagraphOverlapsRange(p, targetRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If p.Format.SpaceBefore <> 0 Or p.Format.SpaceAfter <> 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        ApplyPreviewSpacingBoundary p.Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        cntNormalize = cntNormalize + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doIndent Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For Each p In targetRange.Paragraphs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If ParagraphOverlapsRange(p, targetRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Dim leadingIndentLength As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    leadingIndentLength = ParagraphLeadingIndentLength(p)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If p.Format.LeftIndent <> 0 Or leadingIndentLength > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        If leadingIndentLength > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                            ApplyPreviewHighlight ActiveDocument.Range(p.Range.Start, p.Range.Start + leadingIndentLength)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                            ApplyPreviewShading p.Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        cntIndent = cntIndent + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRows As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set previewRows = NewPreviewSummaryRows()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Empty paragraphs"", cntRemove, False, (Not doRemove)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Soft returns"", cntCollapse, False, (Not doCollapse)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Paragraph spacing"", cntNormalize, False, (Not doNormalize)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Indents"", cntIndent, False, (Not doIndent)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ShowPreviewActionsSummary Me, ""Paragraph Fixer"", previewRows" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""Paragraph Fixer""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - Paragraph Fixer""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ' Perform paragraph cleanup with counting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cntRemove = 0: cntCollapse = 0: cntNormalize = 0: cntIndent = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim replacedThisPass As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doRemove Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        UpdateCleanupProgress ""Removing extra empty paragraphs""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim blankStarts As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim protectedCells As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim protectedRows As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim protectedFinal As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim skippedStructures As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set blankStarts = CollectCollapsibleBlankParagraphStarts(targetRange, True, protectedCells, protectedRows, protectedFinal, skippedStructures)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim blankIndex As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For blankIndex = blankStarts.Count To 1 Step -1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If RemoveCleanupBlankParagraphAtStart(ActiveDocument, CLng(blankStarts(blankIndex))) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                cntRemove = cntRemove + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next blankIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doCollapse Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        UpdateCleanupProgress ""Converting soft returns""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            replacedThisPass = ReplaceParagraphFindMatches(targetRange, ""^l"", ""^p"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            cntCollapse = cntCollapse + replacedThisPass" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Loop While replacedThisPass > 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ' Normalize paragraph spacing" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doNormalize Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        UpdateCleanupProgress ""Normalizing paragraph spacing""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each p In targetRange.Paragraphs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If ParagraphOverlapsRange(p, targetRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                With p.Format" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If .SpaceBefore <> 0 Or .SpaceAfter <> 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        .SpaceBefore = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        .SpaceAfter = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        cntNormalize = cntNormalize + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End With" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ' Fix indent" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doIndent Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        UpdateCleanupProgress ""Fixing manual indents""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim paragraphIndex As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For paragraphIndex = targetRange.Paragraphs.Count To 1 Step -1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set p = targetRange.Paragraphs(paragraphIndex)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If ParagraphOverlapsRange(p, targetRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                leadingIndentLength = ParagraphLeadingIndentLength(p)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If p.Format.LeftIndent <> 0 Or leadingIndentLength > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    p.Format.LeftIndent = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If leadingIndentLength > 0 Then ActiveDocument.Range(p.Range.Start, p.Range.Start + leadingIndentLength).Delete" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    cntIndent = cntIndent + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next paragraphIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RemoveAllHighlighting targetRange" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next: undoRec.EndCustomRecord: On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function ParagraphLeadingIndentLength(ByVal p As Paragraph) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim textValue As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    textValue = p.Range.Text" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = 1 To Len(textValue)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If Mid$(textValue, i, 1) = "" "" Or Mid$(textValue, i, 1) = vbTab Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ParagraphLeadingIndentLength = ParagraphLeadingIndentLength + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Exit For" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function ParagraphCleanupTargetRange(ByVal sourceRange As Range) As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim expanded As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set expanded = sourceRange.Duplicate" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If expanded.Paragraphs.Count > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        expanded.Start = expanded.Paragraphs(1).Range.Start" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        expanded.End = expanded.Paragraphs(expanded.Paragraphs.Count).Range.End" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set ParagraphCleanupTargetRange = expanded" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function HighlightParagraphFindMatches(ByVal searchRange As Range, ByVal findText As String) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim matchRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim searchEnd As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    searchEnd = searchRange.End" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set matchRange = searchRange.Duplicate" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        With matchRange.Find" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .ClearFormatting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .Text = findText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .Forward = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .Wrap = wdFindStop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .MatchWildcards = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Not .Execute Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End With" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ApplyPreviewHighlight matchRange, wdYellow" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        HighlightParagraphFindMatches = HighlightParagraphFindMatches + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        matchRange.Collapse wdCollapseEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If matchRange.Start >= searchEnd Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        matchRange.End = searchEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function ReplaceParagraphFindMatches(ByVal searchRange As Range, ByVal findText As String, ByVal replacementText As String) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim matchRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set matchRange = searchRange.Duplicate" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    With matchRange.Find" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .ClearFormatting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Replacement.ClearFormatting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Text = findText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Replacement.Text = replacementText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Forward = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .Wrap = wdFindStop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        .MatchWildcards = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Do While .Execute(Replace:=wdReplaceOne)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ReplaceParagraphFindMatches = ReplaceParagraphFindMatches + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End With" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmParagraphCleanup_Code = s
End Function

' Duplicate Paragraph Detector
Private Function frmDuplicateDetector_Code() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ReturnToMainAfterToolClose Me, Cancel, CloseMode" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Duplicate Paragraph Remover" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Finds repeated paragraphs and removes all but the first occurrence after" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  preview.  Three matching methods: exact (case-insensitive)," & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  normalized (ignores punctuation and spacing), and fuzzy (groups" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  paragraphs that share a chosen percentage of their words).  Fuzzy" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  matching uses global single-linkage clustering, so the groups it finds" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  do not depend on the order paragraphs appear in the document." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optMatchExact.GroupName = ""DupMatch""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optMatchNormalized.GroupName = ""DupMatch""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optMatchFuzzy.GroupName = ""DupMatch""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optFuzzyLoose.GroupName = ""DupThreshold""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optFuzzyMedium.GroupName = ""DupThreshold""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optFuzzyStrict.GroupName = ""DupThreshold""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.GroupName = ""DupScope""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeSelection.GroupName = ""DupScope""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optMatchExact.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optFuzzyMedium.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkIncludeEmptyParagraphs.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    lblFuzzyWarning.Caption = ""Exact and normalized matching are fast.  Fuzzy matching compares every paragraph and is slower on large documents.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Caption = ""Entire document""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeSelection.Caption = ""Selected text only""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RefreshScopeSelectionState Me, True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optMatchExact.Caption = ""Exact match""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optMatchNormalized.Caption = ""Normalized match (ignore punctuation and spaces)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optMatchFuzzy.Caption = ""Fuzzy match (word overlap)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkIncludeEmptyParagraphs.Caption = ""Include empty paragraphs""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optFuzzyLoose.Caption = ""Loose  (50% word overlap)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optFuzzyMedium.Caption = ""Medium  (70% word overlap)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optFuzzyStrict.Caption = ""Strict  (90% word overlap)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Caption = ""Preview only (highlight, do not change)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutCleanupToolForm Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optMatchExact_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    lblFuzzyWarning.Caption = ""Exact match: paragraphs must be identical apart from letter case.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutCleanupToolForm Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optMatchNormalized_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    lblFuzzyWarning.Caption = ""Normalized match: ignores punctuation, extra spaces, and letter case.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutCleanupToolForm Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optMatchFuzzy_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    lblFuzzyWarning.Caption = ""Fuzzy match: groups paragraphs sharing the chosen percentage of words.  Slower on large documents.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutCleanupToolForm Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function NormalizeText(ByVal t As String, ByVal stripPunct As Boolean) As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim r As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    r = t" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Len(r) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If Right$(r, 1) = vbCr Then r = Left$(r, Len(r) - 1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    r = LCase$(Trim$(r))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If stripPunct Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim i As Long, ch As String, out As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        out = """"" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For i = 1 To Len(r)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ch = Mid$(r, i, 1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If (ch >= ""a"" And ch <= ""z"") Or (ch >= ""0"" And ch <= ""9"") Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                out = out & ch" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ElseIf ch = "" "" Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If Len(out) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If Right$(out, 1) <> "" "" Then out = out & "" """ & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        r = Trim$(out)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    NormalizeText = r" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function BuildWordSet(ByVal t As String) As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject(""Scripting.Dictionary"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    d.CompareMode = 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim norm As String: norm = NormalizeText(t, True)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Len(norm) = 0 Then Set BuildWordSet = d: Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim parts() As String: parts = Split(norm, "" "")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long, w As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = LBound(parts) To UBound(parts)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        w = parts(i)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If Len(w) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Not d.Exists(w) Then d.Add w, 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set BuildWordSet = d" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function JaccardSimilarity(ByVal a As Object, ByVal b As Object) As Double" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If a.Count = 0 And b.Count = 0 Then JaccardSimilarity = 0: Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If a.Count = 0 Or b.Count = 0 Then JaccardSimilarity = 0: Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim sharedCount As Long: sharedCount = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim k As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If a.Count <= b.Count Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each k In a.Keys" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If b.Exists(k) Then sharedCount = sharedCount + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next k" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each k In b.Keys" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If a.Exists(k) Then sharedCount = sharedCount + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next k" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    JaccardSimilarity = sharedCount / (a.Count + b.Count - sharedCount)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function FindRoot(ByRef par() As Long, ByVal x As Long) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Do While par(x) <> x" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        par(x) = par(par(x))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        x = par(x)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    FindRoot = x" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkIncludeEmptyParagraphs_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optFuzzyLoose_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optFuzzyMedium_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optFuzzyStrict_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementDuplicateExact_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Exact match"", ""Inspect first"", ""Finds only paragraphs that match exactly."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementDuplicateNormalized_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Normalized match"", ""Inspect first"", ""Ignores punctuation and spacing differences when finding repeats."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementDuplicateFuzzy_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Fuzzy match"", ""Inspect first"", ""Finds near-duplicates by word overlap and needs human review."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementDuplicateEmpty_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Include empty paragraphs"", ""Removes content"", ""Treats removable blank body and trailing table-cell paragraphs as duplicate candidates while preserving required table-cell and final document markers."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementDuplicateFuzzyLoose_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Loose fuzzy threshold"", ""Inspect first"", ""Finds more possible matches and more false positives."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementDuplicateFuzzyMedium_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Medium fuzzy threshold"", ""Inspect first"", ""Balances catch rate and false positives."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementDuplicateFuzzyStrict_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Strict fuzzy threshold"", ""Inspect first"", ""Finds fewer candidates but reduces false positives."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdPreview_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    PreviewFromPanel" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub PreviewFromPanel()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    BeginPreviewActionIndicator Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    EndPreviewActionIndicator" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdReset_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UserForm_Initialize" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub RunAfterPreview()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRun_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ActiveDocument.ProtectionType <> wdNoProtection Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""This document is protected. Please remove protection before running cleanup."", vbExclamation, ""Document Protected"": Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GuardBeforeCleanup(""Duplicate Paragraph Remover"") Then Unload Me: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewOnly As Boolean: previewOnly = chkPreviewOnly.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim targetRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optScopeSelection.Value And optScopeSelection.Enabled Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = GetTargetRange()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = ActiveDocument.Content" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doRemove As Boolean: doRemove = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim includeEmptyParagraphs As Boolean: includeEmptyParagraphs = chkIncludeEmptyParagraphs.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim matchMode As Integer: matchMode = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optMatchNormalized.Value Then matchMode = 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optMatchFuzzy.Value Then matchMode = 2" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim threshold As Double: threshold = 0.7" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optFuzzyLoose.Value Then threshold = 0.5" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optFuzzyStrict.Value Then threshold = 0.9" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim paras As Collection: Set paras = New Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim p As Paragraph" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim candidateText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim blankKind As CleanupBlankParagraphKind" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim protectedEmptyCells As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim protectedRowMarkers As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim protectedFinalMarkers As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim skippedStructures As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each p In targetRange.Paragraphs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If ParagraphContainedInRange(p, targetRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            candidateText = DuplicateCandidateVisibleText(p.Range.Text)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Len(candidateText) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                paras.Add p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                blankKind = ClassifyCleanupBlankParagraph(p)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Select Case blankKind" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Case cbpkRemovableBody, cbpkRemovableCellExtra" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        If includeEmptyParagraphs Then paras.Add p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Case cbpkProtectedEmptyCell" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        protectedEmptyCells = protectedEmptyCells + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Case cbpkProtectedRowMarker" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        protectedRowMarkers = protectedRowMarkers + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Case cbpkProtectedFinalDocument" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        protectedFinalMarkers = protectedFinalMarkers + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Case cbpkUnsupported" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        skippedStructures = skippedStructures + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End Select" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If matchMode = 2 And paras.Count > 1500 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If MsgBox(""This scope has "" & paras.Count & "" paragraphs. Fuzzy matching compares them all and may take a while. Continue?"", vbQuestion + vbYesNo, ""Fuzzy Match"") = vbNo Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""Duplicate Paragraph Remover""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - Duplicate Paragraph Remover""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.ScreenUpdating = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim duplicateTextCount As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim duplicateEmptyCount As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim dupStarts As Collection: Set dupStarts = New Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long, j As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If matchMode <= 1 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim dict As Object: Set dict = CreateObject(""Scripting.Dictionary"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        dict.CompareMode = 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim key As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For i = 1 To paras.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set p = paras(i)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim candidateIsEmpty As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            candidateIsEmpty = (Len(DuplicateCandidateVisibleText(p.Range.Text)) = 0)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If matchMode = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                key = NormalizeText(p.Range.Text, False)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                key = NormalizeText(p.Range.Text, True)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If candidateIsEmpty Then key = vbNullChar & ""EMPTY_PARAGRAPH""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Len(key) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If dict.Exists(key) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    MarkDuplicateParagraphPreview p, candidateIsEmpty" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    dupStarts.Add p.Range.Start" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If candidateIsEmpty Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        duplicateEmptyCount = duplicateEmptyCount + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        duplicateTextCount = duplicateTextCount + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    dict.Add key, i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If i Mod 100 = 0 Or i = paras.Count Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                UpdateCleanupProgress ""Checking duplicates"", i, paras.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim n As Long: n = paras.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If n > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim wsArr() As Object" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ReDim wsArr(1 To n)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For i = 1 To n" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Set wsArr(i) = BuildWordSet(paras(i).Range.Text)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim par() As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ReDim par(1 To n)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For i = 1 To n" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                par(i) = i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If includeEmptyParagraphs Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim firstEmptyIndex As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                For i = 1 To n" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If Len(DuplicateCandidateVisibleText(paras(i).Range.Text)) = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        If firstEmptyIndex = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                            firstEmptyIndex = i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                            par(i) = firstEmptyIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim ca As Long, cb As Long, mn As Long, mx As Long, ra As Long, rb As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For i = 1 To n - 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ca = wsArr(i).Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If ca > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    For j = i + 1 To n" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        cb = wsArr(j).Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        If cb > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                            If ca <= cb Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                                mn = ca: mx = cb" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                            Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                                mn = cb: mx = ca" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                            If mn / mx >= threshold Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                                If JaccardSimilarity(wsArr(i), wsArr(j)) >= threshold Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                                    ra = FindRoot(par, i)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                                    rb = FindRoot(par, j)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                                    If ra <> rb Then par(ra) = rb" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Next j" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If i Mod 25 = 0 Or i = n - 1 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    UpdateCleanupProgress ""Comparing near duplicates"", i, n" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim rootMin As Object: Set rootMin = CreateObject(""Scripting.Dictionary"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim rt As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For i = 1 To n" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                rt = CStr(FindRoot(par, i))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If rootMin.Exists(rt) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If i < rootMin(rt) Then rootMin(rt) = i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    rootMin.Add rt, i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For i = 1 To n" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                rt = CStr(FindRoot(par, i))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If i <> rootMin(rt) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    MarkDuplicateParagraphPreview paras(i), (Len(DuplicateCandidateVisibleText(paras(i).Range.Text)) = 0)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    dupStarts.Add paras(i).Range.Start" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If Len(DuplicateCandidateVisibleText(paras(i).Range.Text)) = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        duplicateEmptyCount = duplicateEmptyCount + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        duplicateTextCount = duplicateTextCount + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.ScreenUpdating = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If previewOnly Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRows As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set previewRows = NewPreviewSummaryRows()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Text duplicate paragraphs"", duplicateTextCount" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Removable empty paragraphs"", duplicateEmptyCount, False, (Not includeEmptyParagraphs)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Protected empty cells"", protectedEmptyCells, True, (Not includeEmptyParagraphs)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Protected row markers"", protectedRowMarkers, True, (Not includeEmptyParagraphs)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Protected final marker"", protectedFinalMarkers, True, (Not includeEmptyParagraphs)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Skipped structures"", skippedStructures, True, (Not includeEmptyParagraphs)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ShowPreviewActionsSummary Me, ""Duplicate Paragraph Remover"", previewRows" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doRemove Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ' Remove ONLY paragraphs detected as duplicates, identified by the" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ' start positions captured during detection -- never by highlight" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ' colour. This leaves any pre-existing user highlighting untouched." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim removed As Long: removed = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim dn As Long: dn = dupStarts.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If dn > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim ds() As Long, di As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ReDim ds(1 To dn)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For di = 1 To dn: ds(di) = dupStarts(di): Next di" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ' sort start positions descending so each deletion never shifts" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ' the positions of paragraphs still queued for removal" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim a As Long, b As Long, tmpS As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For a = 1 To dn - 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                For b = a + 1 To dn" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If ds(b) > ds(a) Then tmpS = ds(a): ds(a) = ds(b): ds(b) = tmpS" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Next b" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next a" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For di = 1 To dn" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If RemoveDuplicateParagraphAtStart(ds(di)) Then removed = removed + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next di" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.ScreenUpdating = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next: undoRec.EndCustomRecord: On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub MarkDuplicateParagraphPreview(ByVal paragraphItem As Paragraph, ByVal isEmptyParagraph As Boolean)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If isEmptyParagraph Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ApplyPreviewMinimalMarker paragraphItem.Range, False, wdYellow" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ApplyPreviewHighlight paragraphItem.Range, wdYellow" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function RemoveDuplicateParagraphAtStart(ByVal paragraphStart As Long) As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim paragraphItem As Paragraph" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim blankKind As CleanupBlankParagraphKind" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo SafeExit" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set paragraphItem = ActiveDocument.Range(paragraphStart, paragraphStart).Paragraphs(1)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Len(DuplicateCandidateVisibleText(paragraphItem.Range.Text)) = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        blankKind = ClassifyCleanupBlankParagraph(paragraphItem)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        RemoveDuplicateParagraphAtStart = RemoveCleanupBlankParagraphAtStart(ActiveDocument, paragraphStart, blankKind)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    paragraphItem.Range.Delete" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RemoveDuplicateParagraphAtStart = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "SafeExit:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function DuplicateCandidateVisibleText(ByVal paragraphText As String) As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    paragraphText = Replace(paragraphText, vbCr, """")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    paragraphText = Replace(paragraphText, Chr$(1), """")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    paragraphText = Replace(paragraphText, Chr$(7), """")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    DuplicateCandidateVisibleText = Trim$(paragraphText)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmDuplicateDetector_Code = s
End Function

' Font Normalizer
Private Function frmFontNormalizer_Code() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ReturnToMainAfterToolClose Me, Cancel, CloseMode" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Font Normalizer" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Resets direct font overrides back to what the paragraph style defines," & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  eliminating the font chaos that accumulates from copy-paste.  Face and" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  size are reset by default; bold, italic, and colour are opt-in since" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  those properties are more likely to be intentional." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkFontFace.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkFontSize.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkBold.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkItalic.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkFontColor.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Caption = ""Entire document""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeSelection.Caption = ""Selected text only""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RefreshScopeSelectionState Me, True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkFontFace.Caption = ""Normalize font face to document default""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkFontSize.Caption = ""Normalize font size to style-defined size""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkBold.Caption = ""Normalize direct bold overrides""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkItalic.Caption = ""Normalize direct italic overrides""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkFontColor.Caption = ""Remove direct font color overrides""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Caption = ""Preview only (highlight, do not change)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutCleanupToolForm Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkFontFace_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkFontSize_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkBold_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkItalic_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkFontColor_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementFontFace_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Normalize font face"", ""Formatting change"", ""Removes direct font-name overrides so styles can control font face."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementFontSize_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Normalize font size"", ""Formatting change"", ""Removes direct size overrides so styles can control size."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementFontBold_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Normalize bold"", ""Formatting change"", ""Removes manual bolding not supplied by the style."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementFontItalic_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Normalize italic"", ""Formatting change"", ""Removes manual italics not supplied by the style."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementFontColor_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Remove font color overrides"", ""Formatting change"", ""Clears direct font colors so style color can lead."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdPreview_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    PreviewFromPanel" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub PreviewFromPanel()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    BeginPreviewActionIndicator Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    EndPreviewActionIndicator" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdReset_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UserForm_Initialize" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub RunAfterPreview()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRun_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ActiveDocument.ProtectionType <> wdNoProtection Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""This document is protected. Please remove protection before running cleanup."", vbExclamation, ""Document Protected"": Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GuardBeforeCleanup(""Font Normalizer"") Then Unload Me: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewOnly As Boolean: previewOnly = chkPreviewOnly.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim targetRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optScopeSelection.Value And optScopeSelection.Enabled Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = GetTargetRange()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = ActiveDocument.Content" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doFace As Boolean: doFace = chkFontFace.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doSize As Boolean: doSize = chkFontSize.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doBold As Boolean: doBold = chkBold.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doItalic As Boolean: doItalic = chkItalic.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doColor As Boolean: doColor = chkFontColor.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not (doFace Or doSize Or doBold Or doItalic Or doColor) Then MsgBox ""No font properties selected."", vbInformation: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim p As Paragraph" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim styleFont As Font" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim cnt As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If previewOnly Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewFace As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewSize As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewBold As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewItalic As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewColor As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each p In targetRange.Paragraphs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If ParagraphContainedInRange(p, targetRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Set styleFont = Nothing" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Set styleFont = ActiveDocument.Styles(p.Style).Font" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If Not styleFont Is Nothing Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Dim hasDirect As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    hasDirect = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If doFace And p.Range.Font.Name <> styleFont.Name Then hasDirect = True: previewFace = previewFace + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If doSize And p.Range.Font.Size <> styleFont.Size And p.Range.Font.Size > 0 Then hasDirect = True: previewSize = previewSize + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If doBold And p.Range.Font.Bold <> styleFont.Bold Then hasDirect = True: previewBold = previewBold + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If doItalic And p.Range.Font.Italic <> styleFont.Italic Then hasDirect = True: previewItalic = previewItalic + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If doColor And p.Range.Font.Color <> styleFont.Color Then hasDirect = True: previewColor = previewColor + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If hasDirect Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        ApplyPreviewHighlight p.Range, wdYellow" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        cnt = cnt + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRows As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set previewRows = NewPreviewSummaryRows()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Font face"", previewFace, False, (Not doFace)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Font size"", previewSize, False, (Not doSize)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Bold"", previewBold, False, (Not doBold)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Italic"", previewItalic, False, (Not doItalic)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Font color"", previewColor, False, (Not doColor)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ShowPreviewActionsSummary Me, ""Font Normalizer"", previewRows" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""Font Normalizer""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - Font Normalizer""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim cntFixed As Long: cntFixed = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each p In targetRange.Paragraphs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If ParagraphContainedInRange(p, targetRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set styleFont = Nothing" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set styleFont = ActiveDocument.Styles(p.Style).Font" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Not styleFont Is Nothing Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim changed As Boolean: changed = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If doFace Then p.Range.Font.Name = styleFont.Name: changed = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If doSize Then p.Range.Font.Size = styleFont.Size: changed = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If doBold Then p.Range.Font.Bold = styleFont.Bold: changed = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If doItalic Then p.Range.Font.Italic = styleFont.Italic: changed = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If doColor Then p.Range.Font.Color = styleFont.Color: changed = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If changed Then cntFixed = cntFixed + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RemoveAllHighlighting targetRange" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next: undoRec.EndCustomRecord: On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmFontNormalizer_Code = s
End Function

' Table Cleaner
Private Function frmTableCleaner_Code() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private mStructuralPreviewCompleted As Boolean" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "'  to Word defaults (0.04"" top/bottom, 0.08"" left/right), and optionally" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  strips direct table-level formatting, resets or removes border styles, and" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  can convert tables to plain tab-separated text.  Operates on all tables" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    chkNormalizePadding.Value = True" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    chkNormalizeBorders.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkRemoveBorders.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkConvertToText.Value = False" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    LayoutCleanupToolForm Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function CollectEligibleEmptyRowIndexes(ByVal sourceTable As Table, ByRef protectedOrSkipped As Long) As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim indexes As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim rowIndex As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim tableRow As Row" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set indexes = New Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not CleanupTableStructureIsSupported(sourceTable) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        protectedOrSkipped = protectedOrSkipped + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set CollectEligibleEmptyRowIndexes = indexes" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For rowIndex = 1 To sourceTable.Rows.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set tableRow = sourceTable.Rows(rowIndex)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If Not CleanupTableRowHasMeaningfulContent(tableRow) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If sourceTable.Rows.Count <= 1 Or tableRow.HeadingFormat <> 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                protectedOrSkipped = protectedOrSkipped + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                indexes.Add rowIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next rowIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If indexes.Count >= sourceTable.Rows.Count Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        protectedOrSkipped = protectedOrSkipped + indexes.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set indexes = New Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set CollectEligibleEmptyRowIndexes = indexes" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function CollectEligibleEmptyColumnIndexes(ByVal sourceTable As Table, ByRef protectedOrSkipped As Long) As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim indexes As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim columnIndex As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set indexes = New Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not CleanupTableStructureIsSupported(sourceTable) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        protectedOrSkipped = protectedOrSkipped + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set CollectEligibleEmptyColumnIndexes = indexes" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For columnIndex = 1 To sourceTable.Columns.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If Not CleanupTableColumnHasMeaningfulContent(sourceTable, columnIndex) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If sourceTable.Columns.Count <= 1 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                protectedOrSkipped = protectedOrSkipped + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                indexes.Add columnIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next columnIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If indexes.Count >= sourceTable.Columns.Count Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        protectedOrSkipped = protectedOrSkipped + indexes.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set indexes = New Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set CollectEligibleEmptyColumnIndexes = indexes" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    On Error GoTo SafeExit" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not CleanupTableStructureIsSupported(sourceTable) Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If sourceTable.Rows.Count <= 1 Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If rowIndex < 1 Or rowIndex > sourceTable.Rows.Count Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If sourceTable.Rows(rowIndex).HeadingFormat <> 0 Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    TableRowStillEligible = Not CleanupTableRowHasMeaningfulContent(sourceTable.Rows(rowIndex))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "SafeExit:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    If sourceTable.Columns.Count <= 1 Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If columnIndex < 1 Or columnIndex > sourceTable.Columns.Count Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    TableColumnStillEligible = Not CleanupTableColumnHasMeaningfulContent(sourceTable, columnIndex)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "SafeExit:" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementTableBorders_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Normalize borders"", ""Formatting change"", ""Turns table borders back on using standard border behavior."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementTableRemoveBorders_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Remove borders"", ""Formatting change"", ""Removes visible table borders."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementTableConvertToText_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Convert table to text"", ""Structure change"", ""Replaces single-column tables with plain text."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdPreview_Click()" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    EndPreviewActionIndicator" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdReset_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UserForm_Initialize" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub RunAfterPreview()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRun_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ActiveDocument.ProtectionType <> wdNoProtection Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""This document is protected. Please remove protection before running cleanup."", vbExclamation, ""Document Protected"": Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GuardBeforeCleanup(""Table Cleaner"") Then Unload Me: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewOnly As Boolean: previewOnly = chkPreviewOnly.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim targetRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optScopeSelection.Value And optScopeSelection.Enabled Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = GetTargetRange()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = ActiveDocument.Content" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doEmptyRows As Boolean: doEmptyRows = chkRemoveEmptyRows.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doEmptyCols As Boolean: doEmptyCols = chkRemoveEmptyCols.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doPadding As Boolean: doPadding = chkNormalizePadding.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doDirectFmt As Boolean: doDirectFmt = chkStripDirectFormat.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doBorders As Boolean: doBorders = chkNormalizeBorders.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doRemoveBorders As Boolean: doRemoveBorders = chkRemoveBorders.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doConvertText As Boolean: doConvertText = chkConvertToText.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not (doEmptyRows Or doEmptyCols Or doPadding Or doDirectFmt Or doBorders Or doRemoveBorders Or doConvertText) Then MsgBox ""No table options selected."", vbInformation: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ' Collect tables in scope" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim tbl As Table, tablesInScope As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim partiallyScopedTables As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set tablesInScope = New Collection" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "        If tbl.Range.Start >= targetRange.Start And tbl.Range.End <= targetRange.End Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            tablesInScope.Add tbl" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ElseIf tbl.Range.End > targetRange.Start And tbl.Range.Start < targetRange.End Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            partiallyScopedTables = partiallyScopedTables + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next tbl" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If tablesInScope.Count = 0 Then MsgBox ""No tables found in the selected scope."", vbInformation: Unload Me: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If previewOnly Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewEmptyRows As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewProtectedRows As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewCols As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewProtectedCols As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewPadding As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewDirectFmt As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewNormalizeBorders As Long" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "        Dim previewConvertText As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewSkippedConvert As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewProtectedConvert As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewMarkTable As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim t As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each t In tablesInScope" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set tbl = t" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If doEmptyRows Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim rowIndexes As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Set rowIndexes = CollectEligibleEmptyRowIndexes(tbl, previewProtectedRows)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                previewEmptyRows = previewEmptyRows + rowIndexes.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim previewRowCandidate As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                For previewRowCandidate = 1 To rowIndexes.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    ApplyPreviewShading tbl.Rows(CLng(rowIndexes(previewRowCandidate))).Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Next previewRowCandidate" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If doEmptyCols Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim columnIndexes As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Set columnIndexes = CollectEligibleEmptyColumnIndexes(tbl, previewProtectedCols)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                previewCols = previewCols + columnIndexes.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim previewColumnCandidate As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim previewColumnRow As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                For previewColumnCandidate = 1 To columnIndexes.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    For previewColumnRow = 1 To tbl.Rows.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        ApplyPreviewShading tbl.Cell(previewColumnRow, CLng(columnIndexes(previewColumnCandidate))).Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Next previewColumnRow" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Next previewColumnCandidate" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If doPadding Then previewPadding = previewPadding + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If doDirectFmt Then previewDirectFmt = previewDirectFmt + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If doBorders Then previewNormalizeBorders = previewNormalizeBorders + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If doRemoveBorders Then previewRemoveBorders = previewRemoveBorders + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If doConvertText Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If Not CleanupTableStructureIsSupported(tbl) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    previewProtectedConvert = previewProtectedConvert + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ElseIf tbl.Columns.Count = 1 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    previewConvertText = previewConvertText + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    previewSkippedConvert = previewSkippedConvert + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            previewMarkTable = doPadding Or doDirectFmt Or doBorders Or doRemoveBorders" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If doConvertText And tbl.Columns.Count = 1 And CleanupTableStructureIsSupported(tbl) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                previewMarkTable = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If previewMarkTable Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ApplyPreviewMinimalMarker tbl.Range, True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next t" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRows As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set previewRows = NewPreviewSummaryRows()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Empty rows"", previewEmptyRows, False, (Not doEmptyRows)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Protected/skipped rows"", previewProtectedRows, True, (Not doEmptyRows)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Empty columns"", previewCols, False, (Not doEmptyCols)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Protected/skipped columns"", previewProtectedCols, True, (Not doEmptyCols)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Cell padding"", previewPadding, False, (Not doPadding)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Direct cell formatting"", previewDirectFmt, False, (Not doDirectFmt)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Border normalization"", previewNormalizeBorders, False, (Not doBorders)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Border removal"", previewRemoveBorders, False, (Not doRemoveBorders)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Tables to text"", previewConvertText, False, (Not doConvertText)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Skipped multi-column tables"", previewSkippedConvert, True, (Not doConvertText)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Protected/unsupported conversions"", previewProtectedConvert, True, (Not doConvertText)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Partially scoped tables"", partiallyScopedTables, True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        mStructuralPreviewCompleted = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ShowPreviewActionsSummary Me, ""Table Cleaner"", previewRows" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If (doEmptyRows Or doEmptyCols Or doConvertText) And Not mStructuralPreviewCompleted Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""Preview these structural table choices before applying them."", vbInformation, ""Preview Required""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim structuralRowCount As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim structuralColumnCount As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim structuralConvertCount As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim applyProtectedRows As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim applyProtectedColumns As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim applyRowIndexes As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim applyColumnIndexes As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim structuralTable As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each structuralTable In tablesInScope" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set tbl = structuralTable" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doEmptyRows Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set applyRowIndexes = CollectEligibleEmptyRowIndexes(tbl, applyProtectedRows)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            structuralRowCount = structuralRowCount + applyRowIndexes.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doEmptyCols Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set applyColumnIndexes = CollectEligibleEmptyColumnIndexes(tbl, applyProtectedColumns)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            structuralColumnCount = structuralColumnCount + applyColumnIndexes.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doConvertText And tbl.Columns.Count = 1 And CleanupTableStructureIsSupported(tbl) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            structuralConvertCount = structuralConvertCount + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next structuralTable" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If structuralRowCount + structuralColumnCount + structuralConvertCount > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim structuralMessage As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        structuralMessage = ""Apply these structural table changes?"" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                            structuralRowCount & "" empty row(s)"" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                            structuralColumnCount & "" empty column(s)"" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                            structuralConvertCount & "" single-column table conversion(s)"" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                            ""Protected or unsupported structures will be left unchanged.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If MsgBox(structuralMessage, vbExclamation + vbYesNo + vbDefaultButton2, ""Confirm Table Structure Changes"") <> vbYes Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""Table Cleaner""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - Table Cleaner""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim cntRows As Long, cntCols As Long, cntTables As Long, cntConverted As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim tVar As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each tVar In tablesInScope" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        UpdateCleanupProgress ""Cleaning tables"", cntTables + 1, tablesInScope.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set tbl = tVar" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim convertThisTable As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        convertThisTable = (doConvertText And tbl.Columns.Count = 1 And CleanupTableStructureIsSupported(tbl))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doEmptyRows Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set applyRowIndexes = CollectEligibleEmptyRowIndexes(tbl, applyProtectedRows)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim rowCandidateIndex As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For rowCandidateIndex = applyRowIndexes.Count To 1 Step -1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If TableRowStillEligible(tbl, CLng(applyRowIndexes(rowCandidateIndex))) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    tbl.Rows(CLng(applyRowIndexes(rowCandidateIndex))).Delete" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    cntRows = cntRows + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next rowCandidateIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doEmptyCols Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set applyColumnIndexes = CollectEligibleEmptyColumnIndexes(tbl, applyProtectedColumns)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim columnCandidateIndex As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For columnCandidateIndex = applyColumnIndexes.Count To 1 Step -1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If TableColumnStillEligible(tbl, CLng(applyColumnIndexes(columnCandidateIndex))) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    tbl.Columns(CLng(applyColumnIndexes(columnCandidateIndex))).Delete" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    cntCols = cntCols + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next columnCandidateIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doPadding Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            tbl.TopPadding = InchesToPoints(0.04)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            tbl.BottomPadding = InchesToPoints(0.04)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            tbl.LeftPadding = InchesToPoints(0.08)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            tbl.RightPadding = InchesToPoints(0.08)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doDirectFmt Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            tbl.Range.Font.Reset" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            tbl.Range.ParagraphFormat.Reset" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doBorders Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            tbl.Borders.Enable = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doRemoveBorders Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            tbl.Borders.Enable = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        cntTables = cntTables + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If convertThisTable Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            tbl.ConvertToText Separator:=wdSeparateByTabs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            cntConverted = cntConverted + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next tVar" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmTableCleaner_Code = s
End Function

' Break Normalizer
Private Function frmBreakNormalizer_Code() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    fraConvertTo.Enabled = chkConvertSectionBreaks.Value" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "Private Sub optConvertOddPage_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementBreakPages_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Collapse consecutive page breaks"", ""Structure change"", ""Merges repeated manual page breaks and can change pagination."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementBreakEvenPage_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Even Page conversion"", ""Structure change"", ""Forces converted sections to begin on an even page."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
