    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    BeginPreviewActionIndicator Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    EndPreviewActionIndicator" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdReset_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UserForm_Initialize" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub RunAfterPreview()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRun_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ActiveDocument.ProtectionType <> wdNoProtection Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""This document is protected. Please remove protection before running cleanup."", vbExclamation, ""Document Protected"": Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GuardBeforeCleanup(""Break Normalizer"") Then Unload Me: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewOnly As Boolean: previewOnly = chkPreviewOnly.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim targetRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optScopeSelection.Value And optScopeSelection.Enabled Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = GetTargetRange()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = ActiveDocument.Content" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doCollSect As Boolean: doCollSect = chkCollapseSectionBreaks.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doCollPage As Boolean: doCollPage = chkCollapsePageBreaks.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doConvert As Boolean: doConvert = chkConvertSectionBreaks.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not (doCollSect Or doCollPage Or doConvert) Then MsgBox ""No break options selected."", vbInformation: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ' Determine target section start type for conversion" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim targetSectStart As Long: targetSectStart = wdSectionContinuous" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optConvertNextPage.Value Then targetSectStart = wdSectionNewPage" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optConvertContinuous.Value Then targetSectStart = wdSectionContinuous" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optConvertEvenPage.Value Then targetSectStart = wdSectionEvenPage" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optConvertOddPage.Value Then targetSectStart = wdSectionOddPage" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If previewOnly Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewSectionBreaks As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewPageBreaks As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewConversions As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doCollSect Then previewSectionBreaks = HighlightPreviewFindBoundaryMatches(targetRange, ""^b^b"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doCollPage Then previewPageBreaks = HighlightPreviewFindBoundaryMatches(targetRange, ""^m^m"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doConvert Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim previewSec As Section" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For Each previewSec In ActiveDocument.Sections" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If previewSec.Range.Start >= targetRange.Start And previewSec.Range.End <= targetRange.End Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If previewSec.Index > 1 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        previewConversions = previewConversions + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        ApplyPreviewMinimalMarker previewSec.Range, True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next previewSec" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRows As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set previewRows = NewPreviewSummaryRows()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Consecutive section breaks"", previewSectionBreaks, False, (Not doCollSect)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Consecutive page breaks"", previewPageBreaks, False, (Not doCollPage)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Section break conversions"", previewConversions, False, (Not doConvert)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ShowPreviewActionsSummary Me, ""Break Normalizer"", previewRows" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""Break Normalizer""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - Break Normalizer""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim cntSect As Long, cntPage As Long, cntConv As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doCollSect Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        UpdateCleanupProgress ""Collapsing section breaks""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        cntSect = CollapseRepeatedBreaks(targetRange, ""^b^b"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doCollPage Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        UpdateCleanupProgress ""Collapsing page breaks""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        cntPage = CollapseRepeatedBreaks(targetRange, ""^m^m"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doConvert Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        UpdateCleanupProgress ""Converting section breaks""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim sec As Section" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each sec In ActiveDocument.Sections" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If sec.Range.Start >= targetRange.Start And sec.Range.End <= targetRange.End Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If sec.Index > 1 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    sec.PageSetup.SectionStart = targetSectStart" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    cntConv = cntConv + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next sec" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RemoveAllHighlighting targetRange" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next: undoRec.EndCustomRecord: On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function CollapseRepeatedBreaks(ByVal searchRange As Range, ByVal findText As String) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim matchRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim deleteRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set matchRange = searchRange.Duplicate" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        With matchRange.Find" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .ClearFormatting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .Text = findText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .Forward = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .Wrap = wdFindStop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .MatchWildcards = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Not .Execute Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End With" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set deleteRange = matchRange.Duplicate" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        deleteRange.Start = deleteRange.End - 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        deleteRange.Delete" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        CollapseRepeatedBreaks = CollapseRepeatedBreaks + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmBreakNormalizer_Code = s
End Function

' Document Trim
Private Function frmDocumentTrim_Code() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ReturnToMainAfterToolClose Me, Cancel, CloseMode" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Document Trim" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Removes trailing empty paragraphs from the end of the document," & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  leaving exactly one final paragraph (which Word requires).  Always" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  operates on the full document -- ""end of document"" is inherently" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  document-level, so scope selection is disabled for this tool." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ' Scope controls disabled -- this tool always operates on the full document" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    fraScopeSelection.Enabled = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Caption = ""Entire document (always)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeSelection.Enabled = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Caption = ""Preview only (highlight, do not change)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutCleanupToolForm Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdPreview_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    PreviewFromPanel" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub PreviewFromPanel()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    BeginPreviewActionIndicator Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    EndPreviewActionIndicator" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdReset_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UserForm_Initialize" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub RunAfterPreview()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRun_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ActiveDocument.ProtectionType <> wdNoProtection Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""This document is protected. Please remove protection before running cleanup."", vbExclamation, ""Document Protected"": Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GuardBeforeCleanup(""Document Trim"") Then Unload Me: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewOnly As Boolean: previewOnly = chkPreviewOnly.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim trailingStarts As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set trailingStarts = CollectTrailingRemovableBlankStarts(ActiveDocument)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim toRemove As Long: toRemove = trailingStarts.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If previewOnly Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRows As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set previewRows = NewPreviewSummaryRows()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Trailing empty paragraphs"", IIf(toRemove > 0, toRemove, 0)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If toRemove > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For i = 1 To trailingStarts.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ApplyPreviewMinimalMarker ActiveDocument.Range(trailingStarts(i), trailingStarts(i)), False, wdYellow" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ShowPreviewActionsSummary Me, ""Document Trim"", previewRows" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If toRemove <= 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""No trailing empty paragraphs found."", vbInformation" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""Document Trim""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - Document Trim""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim removed As Long: removed = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = 1 To trailingStarts.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If RemoveCleanupBlankParagraphAtStart(ActiveDocument, CLng(trailingStarts(i)), cbpkRemovableBody) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            removed = removed + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next: undoRec.EndCustomRecord: On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function CollectTrailingRemovableBlankStarts(ByVal sourceDocument As Document) As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim starts As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim paragraphIndex As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim paragraphItem As Paragraph" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim blankKind As CleanupBlankParagraphKind" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set starts = New Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For paragraphIndex = sourceDocument.Paragraphs.Count To 1 Step -1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set paragraphItem = sourceDocument.Paragraphs(paragraphIndex)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        blankKind = ClassifyCleanupBlankParagraph(paragraphItem)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If blankKind = cbpkProtectedFinalDocument Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ' Word's required final paragraph is never a removal candidate." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ElseIf blankKind = cbpkRemovableBody Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            starts.Add paragraphItem.Range.Start" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Exit For" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next paragraphIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set CollectTrailingRemovableBlankStarts = starts" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmDocumentTrim_Code = s
End Function

' Direct Formatting Stripper
Private Function frmFormattingStripper_Code() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "'  which resets text to the Normal style, this tool returns each paragraph" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  to exactly what its applied style specifies.  Three emphasis modes" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  balance completeness against speed.  Drop caps are preserved by default;" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  untick 'Preserve drop caps' to reset them too." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    chkPreserveHighlight.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreserveDropCaps.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreserveHighlight.Caption = ""Preserve highlighting""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreserveDropCaps.Caption = ""Preserve drop caps""" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    optScopeSelection.Caption = ""Selected text only""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RefreshScopeSelectionState Me, True" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    chkResetPara.Caption = ""Strip direct paragraph formatting""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optEmphQuick.Caption = ""Quick  (preserve paragraph-level emphasis)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optEmphThorough.Caption = ""Thorough  (preserve word-level emphasis)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optEmphStrip.Caption = ""Strip  (remove all direct formatting)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Caption = ""Preview only (highlight, do not change)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutCleanupToolForm Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optEmphQuick_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    lblSpeedWarning.Caption = ""Quick mode is fast and preserves emphasis that applies to whole paragraphs.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutCleanupToolForm Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optEmphThorough_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    lblSpeedWarning.Caption = ""Thorough mode examines every run individually and preserves word-level emphasis.  On a long document this may take a minute or more.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutCleanupToolForm Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optEmphStrip_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    lblSpeedWarning.Caption = ""Strip mode removes all direct formatting, including bold and italic emphasis.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutCleanupToolForm Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkResetChar_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkResetPara_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkPreserveHighlight_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkPreserveDropCaps_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementFormattingChar_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Strip character formatting"", ""Formatting change"", ""Removes direct font-level formatting while leaving styles in charge."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementFormattingPara_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Strip paragraph formatting"", ""Formatting change"", ""Removes direct paragraph spacing, indents, and alignment."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementFormattingQuick_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Quick emphasis preservation"", ""Inspect first"", ""Preserves emphasis that applies to whole paragraphs."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementFormattingThorough_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Thorough emphasis preservation"", ""Inspect first"", ""Checks smaller text runs and may take longer."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementFormattingStrip_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Strip all direct emphasis"", ""Formatting change"", ""Removes manual emphasis such as direct bold and italic."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementFormattingHighlight_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Preserve highlighting"", ""Safe cleanup"", ""Leaves highlighting in place while other direct formatting is stripped."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementFormattingDropCaps_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Preserve drop caps"", ""Safe cleanup"", ""Leaves decorative drop caps in place."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdPreview_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    PreviewFromPanel" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub PreviewFromPanel()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    BeginPreviewActionIndicator Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    EndPreviewActionIndicator" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdReset_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UserForm_Initialize" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub RunAfterPreview()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRun_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ActiveDocument.ProtectionType <> wdNoProtection Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""This document is protected. Please remove protection before running cleanup."", vbExclamation, ""Document Protected"": Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GuardBeforeCleanup(""Formatting Stripper"") Then Unload Me: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewOnly As Boolean: previewOnly = chkPreviewOnly.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim targetRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optScopeSelection.Value And optScopeSelection.Enabled Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = GetTargetRange()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = ActiveDocument.Content" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doResetChar As Boolean: doResetChar = chkResetChar.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doResetPara As Boolean: doResetPara = chkResetPara.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim preserveHL As Boolean: preserveHL = chkPreserveHighlight.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim preserveDC As Boolean: preserveDC = chkPreserveDropCaps.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not (doResetChar Or doResetPara) Then MsgBox ""Nothing selected to reset. Tick at least one reset option."", vbInformation: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim p As Paragraph" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewChar As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewPara As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If previewOnly Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each p In targetRange.Paragraphs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If ParagraphContainedInRange(p, targetRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim hasDirectCharacterFormatting As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim hasDirectParagraphFormatting As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                GetDirectFormattingFlags p, doResetChar, doResetPara, _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                                         hasDirectCharacterFormatting, hasDirectParagraphFormatting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If hasDirectCharacterFormatting Then previewChar = previewChar + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If hasDirectParagraphFormatting Then previewPara = previewPara + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If hasDirectCharacterFormatting Or hasDirectParagraphFormatting Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    ApplyPreviewHighlight p.Range, wdYellow" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRows As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set previewRows = NewPreviewSummaryRows()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Character formatting"", previewChar, False, (Not doResetChar)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Paragraph formatting"", previewPara, False, (Not doResetPara)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ShowPreviewActionsSummary Me, ""Formatting Stripper"", previewRows" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim emphMode As Integer: emphMode = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optEmphThorough.Value Then emphMode = 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optEmphStrip.Value Then emphMode = 2" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If emphMode = 1 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim totalChars As Long: totalChars = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each p In targetRange.Paragraphs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If ParagraphContainedInRange(p, targetRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                totalChars = totalChars + p.Range.Characters.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If totalChars > 20000 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If MsgBox(""This document has "" & totalChars & "" characters in scope."" & vbCrLf & ""Thorough cleaning may take a while. Continue?"", vbQuestion + vbYesNo, ""Thorough Clean"") = vbNo Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""Formatting Stripper""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - Formatting Stripper""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.ScreenUpdating = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim cntReset As Long: cntReset = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim processed As Long: processed = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim paragraphsToProcess As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    paragraphsToProcess = targetRange.Paragraphs.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each p In targetRange.Paragraphs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If ParagraphContainedInRange(p, targetRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ApplyStripToParagraph p, doResetChar, doResetPara, emphMode, preserveHL, preserveDC" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            cntReset = cntReset + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            processed = processed + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If emphMode = 1 And (processed Mod 25 = 0 Or processed = paragraphsToProcess) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                UpdateCleanupProgress ""Cleaning formatting"", processed, paragraphsToProcess" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next p" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.ScreenUpdating = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.ScreenUpdating = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next: undoRec.EndCustomRecord: On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub GetDirectFormattingFlags(ByVal p As Paragraph, _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                                     ByVal checkCharacterFormatting As Boolean, _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                                     ByVal checkParagraphFormatting As Boolean, _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                                     ByRef hasCharacterFormatting As Boolean, _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                                     ByRef hasParagraphFormatting As Boolean)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim paragraphRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim paragraphFormat As ParagraphFormat" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim styleItem As Style" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    hasCharacterFormatting = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    hasParagraphFormatting = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo SafeExit" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set paragraphRange = p.Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set paragraphFormat = paragraphRange.ParagraphFormat" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set styleItem = ActiveDocument.Styles(p.Style)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If styleItem Is Nothing Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If checkCharacterFormatting Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If paragraphRange.Font.Name <> styleItem.Font.Name Then hasCharacterFormatting = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If paragraphRange.Font.Size <> styleItem.Font.Size And paragraphRange.Font.Size > 0 Then hasCharacterFormatting = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If paragraphRange.Font.Bold <> styleItem.Font.Bold Then hasCharacterFormatting = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If paragraphRange.Font.Italic <> styleItem.Font.Italic Then hasCharacterFormatting = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If paragraphRange.Font.Color <> styleItem.Font.Color Then hasCharacterFormatting = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If checkParagraphFormatting Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If paragraphFormat.LeftIndent <> styleItem.ParagraphFormat.LeftIndent Then hasParagraphFormatting = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If paragraphFormat.SpaceBefore <> styleItem.ParagraphFormat.SpaceBefore Then hasParagraphFormatting = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If paragraphFormat.SpaceAfter <> styleItem.ParagraphFormat.SpaceAfter Then hasParagraphFormatting = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If paragraphFormat.Alignment <> styleItem.ParagraphFormat.Alignment Then hasParagraphFormatting = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "SafeExit:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub ApplyStripToParagraph(p As Paragraph, doChar As Boolean, doPara As Boolean, emphMode As Integer, preserveHL As Boolean, preserveDropCaps As Boolean)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not preserveDropCaps Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        p.DropCap.Position = wdDropNone" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not doChar Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doPara Then p.Range.ParagraphFormat.Reset" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If emphMode = 2 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        p.Range.Font.Reset" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doPara Then p.Range.ParagraphFormat.Reset" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ElseIf emphMode = 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim wasBold As Variant, wasItalic As Variant, savedHL As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        wasBold = p.Range.Font.Bold" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        wasItalic = p.Range.Font.Italic" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        savedHL = p.Range.HighlightColorIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        p.Range.Font.Reset" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doPara Then p.Range.ParagraphFormat.Reset" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If wasBold = True Then p.Range.Font.Bold = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If wasItalic = True Then p.Range.Font.Italic = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If preserveHL And savedHL <> wdUndefined And savedHL <> wdNoHighlight Then p.Range.HighlightColorIndex = savedHL" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim n As Long: n = p.Range.Characters.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If n < 1 Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim bArr() As Boolean, iArr() As Boolean, hArr() As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ReDim bArr(1 To n)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ReDim iArr(1 To n)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ReDim hArr(1 To n)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim ch As Range, idx As Long: idx = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For Each ch In p.Range.Characters" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            idx = idx + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If idx <= n Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                bArr(idx) = (ch.Font.Bold = True)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                iArr(idx) = (ch.Font.Italic = True)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                hArr(idx) = ch.HighlightColorIndex" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next ch" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim baseStart As Long: baseStart = p.Range.Start" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        p.Range.Font.Reset" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doPara Then p.Range.ParagraphFormat.Reset" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ApplyRuns baseStart, bArr, iArr, hArr, n, preserveHL" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub ApplyRuns(baseStart As Long, bArr() As Boolean, iArr() As Boolean, hArr() As Long, n As Long, preserveHL As Boolean)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    i = 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Do While i <= n" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If bArr(i) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim jb As Long: jb = i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Do While jb < n" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If Not bArr(jb + 1) Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                jb = jb + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ActiveDocument.Range(baseStart + i - 1, baseStart + jb).Font.Bold = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            i = jb + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            i = i + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    i = 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Do While i <= n" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If iArr(i) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim ji As Long: ji = i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Do While ji < n" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If Not iArr(ji + 1) Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ji = ji + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ActiveDocument.Range(baseStart + i - 1, baseStart + ji).Font.Italic = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            i = ji + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            i = i + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If preserveHL Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        i = 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Do While i <= n" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If hArr(i) <> wdNoHighlight And hArr(i) <> wdUndefined Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim jh As Long: jh = i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Do While jh < n" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If hArr(jh + 1) <> hArr(i) Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    jh = jh + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ActiveDocument.Range(baseStart + i - 1, baseStart + jh).HighlightColorIndex = hArr(i)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                i = jh + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                i = i + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmFormattingStripper_Code = s
End Function

' Master launcher form code (simple)
' Hyperlink Remover
Private Function frmHyperlinkRemover_Code() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ReturnToMainAfterToolClose Me, Cancel, CloseMode" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Hyperlink Cleaner" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Either hides visible hyperlink styling while keeping the link target, or" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  removes hyperlink targets while keeping the visible text." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optHideLinks.GroupName = ""HLAction""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optRemoveLinks.GroupName = ""HLAction""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optHideLinks.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.GroupName = ""HLScope""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeSelection.GroupName = ""HLScope""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optHideLinks.Caption = ""Hide hyperlink styling, keep links""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optRemoveLinks.Caption = ""Remove hyperlinks, keep visible text""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Caption = ""Entire document""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeSelection.Caption = ""Selected text only""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RefreshScopeSelectionState Me, True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Caption = ""Preview only (highlight, do not change)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutHyperlinkForm" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub LayoutHyperlinkForm()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutCleanupToolForm Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optHideLinks_Click(): LayoutHyperlinkForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optRemoveLinks_Click(): LayoutHyperlinkForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementHyperlinkHide_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Hide hyperlink styling"", ""Formatting change"", ""This keeps the hyperlink target but clears the visible blue underline styling so the text looks normal until someone hovers over or opens the link.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementHyperlinkRemove_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Remove hyperlinks"", ""Removes content"", ""This removes the hyperlink target from the document while keeping the visible text.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdPreview_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    PreviewFromPanel" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub PreviewFromPanel()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    BeginPreviewActionIndicator Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    EndPreviewActionIndicator" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdReset_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UserForm_Initialize" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub RunAfterPreview()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRun_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ActiveDocument.ProtectionType <> wdNoProtection Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""This document is protected. Please remove protection before running cleanup."", vbExclamation, ""Document Protected"": Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GuardBeforeCleanup(""Hyperlink Cleaner"") Then Unload Me: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewOnly As Boolean: previewOnly = chkPreviewOnly.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim targetRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optScopeSelection.Value And optScopeSelection.Enabled Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = GetTargetRange()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = ActiveDocument.Content" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim removeLinks As Boolean: removeLinks = optRemoveLinks.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim i As Long, cnt As Long: cnt = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If previewOnly Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For i = 1 To ActiveDocument.Hyperlinks.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim hp As Hyperlink: Set hp = ActiveDocument.Hyperlinks(i)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If hp.Range.Start >= targetRange.Start And hp.Range.End <= targetRange.End Then ApplyPreviewHighlight hp.Range, wdYellow: cnt = cnt + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRows As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set previewRows = NewPreviewSummaryRows()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Hyperlinks"", cnt" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ShowPreviewActionsSummary Me, ""Hyperlink Cleaner"", previewRows" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""Hyperlink Cleaner""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - Hyperlink Cleaner""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For i = ActiveDocument.Hyperlinks.Count To 1 Step -1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim hl As Hyperlink: Set hl = ActiveDocument.Hyperlinks(i)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If hl.Range.Start >= targetRange.Start And hl.Range.End <= targetRange.End Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If removeLinks Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim rg As Range: Set rg = hl.Range.Duplicate" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ClearHyperlinkVisibleStyle rg" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                hl.Delete" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                cnt = cnt + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ClearHyperlinkVisibleStyle hl.Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                cnt = cnt + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RemoveAllHighlighting ActiveDocument.Content" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next: undoRec.EndCustomRecord: On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub ClearHyperlinkVisibleStyle(ByVal target As Range)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    target.Font.Underline = wdUnderlineNone" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    target.Font.ColorIndex = wdAuto" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmHyperlinkRemover_Code = s
End Function

' Soft Return Converter
Private Function frmSoftReturnConverter_Code() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ReturnToMainAfterToolClose Me, Cancel, CloseMode" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Soft Return Converter" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Converts soft returns (Shift+Enter line breaks) to real paragraph marks," & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  or the reverse.  Imported text from PDFs and web pages is often riddled" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  with soft returns that look like paragraph breaks but break styles," & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  spell-check, and spacing." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optSoftToPara.GroupName = ""SoftDir""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optParaToSoft.GroupName = ""SoftDir""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optSoftToPara.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.GroupName = ""SoftScope""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeSelection.GroupName = ""SoftScope""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Caption = ""Entire document""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeSelection.Caption = ""Selected text only""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RefreshScopeSelectionState Me, True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optSoftToPara.Caption = ""Convert soft returns (Shift+Enter) to paragraph marks""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optParaToSoft.Caption = ""Convert paragraph marks to soft returns""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Caption = ""Preview only (highlight, do not change)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutCleanupToolForm Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optSoftToPara_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub optParaToSoft_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementSoftReturnToPara_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Soft returns to paragraphs"", ""Structure change"", ""Turns Shift+Enter line breaks into paragraph marks."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementSoftReturnToSoft_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Paragraphs to soft returns"", ""Structure change"", ""Turns paragraph marks into soft returns in the selected scope."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdPreview_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    PreviewFromPanel" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub PreviewFromPanel()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    BeginPreviewActionIndicator Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    EndPreviewActionIndicator" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdReset_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UserForm_Initialize" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub RunAfterPreview()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRun_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ActiveDocument.ProtectionType <> wdNoProtection Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""This document is protected. Please remove protection before running cleanup."", vbExclamation, ""Document Protected"": Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GuardBeforeCleanup(""Soft Return Converter"") Then Unload Me: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewOnly As Boolean: previewOnly = chkPreviewOnly.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim targetRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optScopeSelection.Value And optScopeSelection.Enabled Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = GetTargetRange()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = ActiveDocument.Content" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim softToPara As Boolean: softToPara = optSoftToPara.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If previewOnly Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim pc As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRows As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        RemoveAllHighlighting ActiveDocument.Content" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        pc = CountSoftReturnConvertibleMarks(targetRange, softToPara)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Call HighlightSoftReturnConvertibleMarks(targetRange, softToPara)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set previewRows = NewPreviewSummaryRows()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Soft returns"", IIf(softToPara, pc, 0), False, (Not softToPara)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Paragraph marks"", IIf(softToPara, 0, pc), False, softToPara" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ShowPreviewActionsSummary Me, ""Soft Return Converter"", previewRows" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""Soft Return Converter""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - Soft Return Converter""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim cnt As Long: cnt = ReplaceSoftReturnMarks(targetRange, softToPara)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RemoveAllHighlighting ActiveDocument.Content" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next: undoRec.EndCustomRecord: On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function CountSoftReturnConvertibleMarks(ByVal searchRange As Range, ByVal softToPara As Boolean) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If softToPara Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        CountSoftReturnConvertibleMarks = CountSoftReturnCharacters(searchRange.Text, Chr$(11))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        CountSoftReturnConvertibleMarks = CountSoftReturnCharacters(searchRange.Text, Chr$(13))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If Right$(searchRange.Text, 1) = Chr$(13) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If CountSoftReturnConvertibleMarks > 0 Then CountSoftReturnConvertibleMarks = CountSoftReturnConvertibleMarks - 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function HighlightSoftReturnConvertibleMarks(ByVal searchRange As Range, ByVal softToPara As Boolean) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim matchRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim searchEnd As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim findText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    searchEnd = searchRange.End" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If softToPara Then findText = ""^l"" Else findText = ""^p""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set matchRange = searchRange.Duplicate" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        With matchRange.Find" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .ClearFormatting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .Text = findText" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .Forward = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .Wrap = wdFindStop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .MatchWildcards = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Not .Execute Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End With" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If (Not softToPara) And matchRange.End >= searchEnd Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        HighlightSoftReturnConvertibleMarks = HighlightSoftReturnConvertibleMarks + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ApplyPreviewMinimalMarker matchRange" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        matchRange.Collapse wdCollapseEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If matchRange.Start >= searchEnd Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        matchRange.End = searchEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function CountSoftReturnCharacters(ByVal textValue As String, ByVal markChar As String) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    CountSoftReturnCharacters = Len(textValue) - Len(Replace(textValue, markChar, """"))" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function ReplaceSoftReturnMarks(ByVal searchRange As Range, ByVal softToPara As Boolean) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim matchRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim searchEnd As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim nextStart As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    searchEnd = searchRange.End" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set matchRange = ActiveDocument.Range(searchRange.Start, searchEnd)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Do While matchRange.Start < searchEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        With matchRange.Find" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .ClearFormatting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If softToPara Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                .Text = ""^l""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                .Text = ""^p""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .Forward = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .Wrap = wdFindStop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            .MatchWildcards = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Not .Execute Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End With" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ' A terminal selected paragraph mark belongs to the boundary with" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ' unselected content. Converting it would merge and reformat the" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ' paragraph after the selection." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If (Not softToPara) And matchRange.End >= searchEnd Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If softToPara Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            matchRange.Text = Chr$(13)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If matchRange.End >= ActiveDocument.Content.End Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            matchRange.Text = Chr$(11)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ReplaceSoftReturnMarks = ReplaceSoftReturnMarks + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        nextStart = matchRange.End" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If nextStart >= searchEnd Then Exit Do" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set matchRange = ActiveDocument.Range(nextStart, searchEnd)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmSoftReturnConverter_Code = s
End Function
