' Final Review
Private Function frmFinalReview_Code() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ReturnToMainAfterToolClose Me, Cancel, CloseMode" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Final Review" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Finalizes review markup before a document is shared by" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  removing comments and/or accepting tracked changes. Always" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  operates on the whole document." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkComments.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkRevisions.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    fraScopeSelection.Enabled = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Caption = ""Entire document (always)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeSelection.Enabled = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkComments.Caption = ""Remove all comments""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkRevisions.Caption = ""Accept tracked changes and clear revision marks""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Caption = ""Preview only (highlight, do not change)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdAuthorCleanupMinimal.Caption = ""Author Cleanup - Minimal""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdAuthorCleanupNormal.Caption = ""Author Cleanup - Normal""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdAuthorCleanupBroad.Caption = ""Author Cleanup - Broad""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutFinalReviewForm" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub LayoutFinalReviewForm()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutCleanupToolForm Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkComments_Click(): LayoutFinalReviewForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkRevisions_Click(): LayoutFinalReviewForm: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdPreview_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    PreviewFromPanel" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub PreviewFromPanel()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    BeginPreviewActionIndicator Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    EndPreviewActionIndicator" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdReset_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UserForm_Initialize" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub RunAfterPreview()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdAuthorCleanupMinimal_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not ConfirmAuthorCleanup(""minimal"", ""Undoability: partially undoable or not reliably undoable."") Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RunFinalReviewAuthorCleanup ""minimal""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox ""Author cleanup completed."" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & ""Undoability: partially undoable or not reliably undoable."", vbInformation, ""Final Review""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdAuthorCleanupNormal_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not ConfirmAuthorCleanup(""normal"", ""Undoability: partially undoable or not reliably undoable."") Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RunFinalReviewAuthorCleanup ""normal""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox ""Author cleanup completed."" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & ""Undoability: partially undoable or not reliably undoable."", vbInformation, ""Final Review""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdAuthorCleanupBroad_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not ConfirmAuthorCleanup(""broad"", ""Undoability: effectively final; treat as permanent once saved."") Then Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RunFinalReviewAuthorCleanup ""broad""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox ""Author cleanup completed."" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & ""Undoability: effectively final; treat as permanent once saved."", vbInformation, ""Final Review""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRun_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ActiveDocument.ProtectionType <> wdNoProtection Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""This document is protected. Please remove protection before running cleanup."", vbExclamation, ""Document Protected"": Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GuardBeforeCleanup(""Final Review"") Then Unload Me: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewOnly As Boolean: previewOnly = chkPreviewOnly.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doComments As Boolean: doComments = chkComments.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doRevisions As Boolean: doRevisions = chkRevisions.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not (doComments Or doRevisions) Then MsgBox ""Nothing selected to finalize."", vbInformation: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If previewOnly Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewComments As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRevisions As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doComments Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim previewComment As Comment" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For Each previewComment In ActiveDocument.Comments" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                previewComments = previewComments + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ApplyPreviewMinimalMarker previewComment.Scope, True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next previewComment" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doRevisions Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim previewRevision As Revision" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For Each previewRevision In ActiveDocument.Revisions" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                previewRevisions = previewRevisions + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ApplyPreviewMinimalMarker previewRevision.Range, True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next previewRevision" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRows As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set previewRows = NewPreviewSummaryRows()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Comments"", previewComments, False, (Not doComments)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Tracked changes"", previewRevisions, False, (Not doRevisions)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ShowPreviewActionsSummary Me, ""Final Review"", previewRows" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""Final Review""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - Final Review""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doComments Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim commentCount As Long: commentCount = ActiveDocument.Comments.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If commentCount > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ActiveDocument.DeleteAllComments" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doRevisions Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim revisionCount As Long: revisionCount = ActiveDocument.Revisions.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If revisionCount > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            ActiveDocument.Revisions.AcceptAll" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next: undoRec.EndCustomRecord: On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function ConfirmAuthorCleanup(ByVal removalLevel As String, ByVal undoabilityWarning As String) As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim promptText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    previewText = PreviewFinalReviewAuthorCleanup(removalLevel)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    promptText = ""Final Review author cleanup preview:"" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                 previewText & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                 undoabilityWarning & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                 ""Continue?""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If MsgBox(promptText, vbQuestion + vbYesNo + vbDefaultButton2, ""Final Review Author Cleanup"") <> vbYes Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ConfirmAuthorCleanup = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmFinalReview_Code = s
End Function

' Style Cleanup
Private Function frmStyleCleanup_Code() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ReturnToMainAfterToolClose Me, Cancel, CloseMode" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Style Cleanup" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Removes unused custom styles and optionally remaps common variant styles" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  (Normal (Web), Body Text 2, etc.) to the Normal style.  Built-in Word" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  styles are never deleted.  Always operates on the whole document." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkRemoveUnused.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkRemapVariants.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    fraScopeSelection.Enabled = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Caption = ""Entire document (always)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeSelection.Enabled = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkRemoveUnused.Caption = ""Remove unused styles""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkRemapVariants.Caption = ""Remap style variants to canonical equivalents""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Caption = ""Preview only (highlight, do not change)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutCleanupToolForm Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function RemappableStyleNames() As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RemappableStyleNames = Array(""Normal (Web)"", ""Body Text 2"", ""Body Text 3"", ""Body Text Indent"", ""Body Text Indent 2"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function TryGetDocumentStyle(ByVal styleName As String, ByRef foundStyle As Style) As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set foundStyle = Nothing" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set foundStyle = ActiveDocument.Styles(styleName)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    TryGetDocumentStyle = Not foundStyle Is Nothing" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function ParagraphUsesStyle(ByVal paragraphItem As Paragraph, ByVal targetStyle As Style) As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim appliedStyle As Style" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo NotMatched" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set appliedStyle = paragraphItem.Range.Style" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ParagraphUsesStyle = (StrComp(appliedStyle.NameLocal, targetStyle.NameLocal, vbTextCompare) = 0)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "NotMatched:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ParagraphUsesStyle = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function CountParagraphsUsingStyle(ByVal targetStyle As Style) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim firstStory As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim storyPart As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim paragraphItem As Paragraph" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each firstStory In ActiveDocument.StoryRanges" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set storyPart = firstStory" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Do While Not storyPart Is Nothing" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For Each paragraphItem In storyPart.Paragraphs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If ParagraphUsesStyle(paragraphItem, targetStyle) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    CountParagraphsUsingStyle = CountParagraphsUsingStyle + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next paragraphItem" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set storyPart = storyPart.NextStoryRange" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next firstStory" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function StyleInUse(ByVal targetStyle As Style) As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If CountParagraphsUsingStyle(targetStyle) > 0 Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        StyleInUse = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim firstStory As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim storyPart As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim searchRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each firstStory In ActiveDocument.StoryRanges" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set storyPart = firstStory" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Do While Not storyPart Is Nothing" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set searchRange = storyPart.Duplicate" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            With searchRange.Find" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                .ClearFormatting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                .Replacement.ClearFormatting" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                .Text = ""^?""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                .Style = targetStyle" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                .Format = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                .Forward = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                .Wrap = wdFindStop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                .MatchWildcards = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If .Execute Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    StyleInUse = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End With" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set storyPart = storyPart.NextStoryRange" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next firstStory" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function RemapStyle(ByVal fromName As String, ByVal toName As String) As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim sourceStyle As Style" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim targetStyle As Style" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not TryGetDocumentStyle(fromName, sourceStyle) Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not TryGetDocumentStyle(toName, targetStyle) Then Exit Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim firstStory As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim storyPart As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim paragraphItem As Paragraph" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each firstStory In ActiveDocument.StoryRanges" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set storyPart = firstStory" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Do While Not storyPart Is Nothing" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For Each paragraphItem In storyPart.Paragraphs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If ParagraphUsesStyle(paragraphItem, sourceStyle) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    paragraphItem.Range.Style = targetStyle" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    RemapStyle = RemapStyle + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next paragraphItem" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set storyPart = storyPart.NextStoryRange" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next firstStory" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkRemoveUnused_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkRemapVariants_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementStyleRemoveUnused_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Remove unused styles"", ""Structure change"", ""Deletes custom styles that are not applied in the document."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementStyleRemap_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Remap style variants"", ""Inspect first"", ""Moves content from lookalike styles into canonical styles."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdPreview_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    PreviewFromPanel" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub PreviewFromPanel()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    BeginPreviewActionIndicator Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    EndPreviewActionIndicator" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdReset_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UserForm_Initialize" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub RunAfterPreview()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRun_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ActiveDocument.ProtectionType <> wdNoProtection Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""This document is protected. Please remove protection before running cleanup."", vbExclamation, ""Document Protected"": Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GuardBeforeCleanup(""Style Cleanup"") Then Unload Me: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewOnly As Boolean: previewOnly = chkPreviewOnly.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doUnused As Boolean: doUnused = chkRemoveUnused.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doRemap As Boolean: doRemap = chkRemapVariants.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not (doUnused Or doRemap) Then MsgBox ""Nothing selected."", vbInformation: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim st As Style" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If previewOnly Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewUnused As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRemaps As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doUnused Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For Each st In ActiveDocument.Styles" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If Not st.BuiltIn Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If Not StyleInUse(st) Then previewUnused = previewUnused + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next st" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doRemap Then previewRemaps = HighlightStyleVariantsForRemap()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRows As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set previewRows = NewPreviewSummaryRows()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Unused custom styles"", previewUnused, True, (Not doUnused)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Variant style remaps"", previewRemaps, False, (Not doRemap)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ShowPreviewActionsSummary Me, ""Style Cleanup"", previewRows" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""Style Cleanup""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - Style Cleanup""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim cntRemap As Long: cntRemap = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim cntUnused As Long: cntUnused = 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doRemap Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim variants As Variant, vi As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        variants = RemappableStyleNames()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For vi = LBound(variants) To UBound(variants)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            UpdateCleanupProgress ""Remapping style variants"", vi - LBound(variants) + 1, UBound(variants) - LBound(variants) + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            cntRemap = cntRemap + RemapStyle(CStr(variants(vi)), ""Normal"")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next vi" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doUnused Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For i = ActiveDocument.Styles.Count To 1 Step -1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If i Mod 25 = 0 Or i = ActiveDocument.Styles.Count Then UpdateCleanupProgress ""Checking unused styles"", ActiveDocument.Styles.Count - i + 1, ActiveDocument.Styles.Count" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Set st = ActiveDocument.Styles(i)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If Not st.BuiltIn Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If Not StyleInUse(st) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    st.Delete" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    If Err.Number = 0 Then cntUnused = cntUnused + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Err.Clear" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next: undoRec.EndCustomRecord: On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function CountStyleVariantsForRemap() As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim variants As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim vi As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim variantStyle As Style" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    variants = RemappableStyleNames()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For vi = LBound(variants) To UBound(variants)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If TryGetDocumentStyle(CStr(variants(vi)), variantStyle) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            CountStyleVariantsForRemap = CountStyleVariantsForRemap + CountParagraphsUsingStyle(variantStyle)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next vi" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function HighlightStyleVariantsForRemap() As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim variants As Variant" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim vi As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim variantStyle As Style" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim firstStory As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim storyPart As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim paragraphItem As Paragraph" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    variants = RemappableStyleNames()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For vi = LBound(variants) To UBound(variants)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If TryGetDocumentStyle(CStr(variants(vi)), variantStyle) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For Each firstStory In ActiveDocument.StoryRanges" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Set storyPart = firstStory" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Do While Not storyPart Is Nothing" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    For Each paragraphItem In storyPart.Paragraphs" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        If ParagraphUsesStyle(paragraphItem, variantStyle) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                            HighlightStyleVariantsForRemap = HighlightStyleVariantsForRemap + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                            ApplyPreviewMinimalMarker paragraphItem.Range, True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Next paragraphItem" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    Set storyPart = storyPart.NextStoryRange" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Loop" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next firstStory" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next vi" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmStyleCleanup_Code = s
End Function

Private Function frmFootnoteRemover_Code() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    ReturnToMainAfterToolClose Me, Cancel, CloseMode" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Footnote / Endnote Remover" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Deletes footnotes and/or endnotes (reference mark and note text)." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Optionally keeps each note's text inline, in square brackets, at the" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  reference point.  Word renumbers any remaining notes automatically." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "'  Works on the whole document or the current selection." & vbCrLf
    s = s & "' --------------------------------------------------------------" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkFootnotes.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkEndnotes.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkKeepTextInline.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkFootnotes.Caption = ""Remove footnotes""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkEndnotes.Caption = ""Remove endnotes""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkKeepTextInline.Caption = ""Keep note text inline [in brackets] instead of deleting it""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Caption = ""Entire document""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeDocument.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    optScopeSelection.Caption = ""Selected text only""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    RefreshScopeSelectionState Me, True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Caption = ""Preview only (highlight, do not change)""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    LayoutCleanupToolForm Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function InScope(r As Range, targetRange As Range) As Boolean" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    InScope = (r.Start >= targetRange.Start And r.Start <= targetRange.End)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkFootnotes_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkEndnotes_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub chkKeepTextInline_Click(): LayoutCleanupToolForm Me: End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementFootnoteFootnotes_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Remove footnotes"", ""Removes content"", ""Deletes footnotes and their reference marks."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementFootnoteEndnotes_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Remove endnotes"", ""Removes content"", ""Deletes endnotes and their reference marks."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRiskPlacementFootnoteKeepText_Click(): ShowToolRiskChoiceExplanation ""Keep note text inline"", ""Text caution"", ""Copies note wording into the document before removing the note itself."" : End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdPreview_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    PreviewFromPanel" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub PreviewFromPanel()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    BeginPreviewActionIndicator Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    EndPreviewActionIndicator" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdReset_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    UserForm_Initialize" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Public Sub RunAfterPreview()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkPreviewOnly.Value = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdRun_Click" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Sub cmdRun_Click()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If ActiveDocument.ProtectionType <> wdNoProtection Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        MsgBox ""This document is protected. Please remove protection before running cleanup."", vbExclamation, ""Document Protected"": Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not GuardBeforeCleanup(""Footnote / Endnote Remover"") Then Unload Me: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim previewOnly As Boolean: previewOnly = chkPreviewOnly.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim targetRange As Range" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If optScopeSelection.Value And optScopeSelection.Enabled Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = GetTargetRange()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set targetRange = ActiveDocument.Content" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doFoot As Boolean: doFoot = chkFootnotes.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim doEnd As Boolean: doEnd = chkEndnotes.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim keepText As Boolean: keepText = chkKeepTextInline.Value" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If Not (doFoot Or doEnd) Then MsgBox ""Select footnotes, endnotes, or both."", vbInformation: Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If previewOnly Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim pf As Long, pe As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim fnP As Footnote, enP As Endnote" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doFoot Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For Each fnP In ActiveDocument.Footnotes" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If InScope(fnP.Reference, targetRange) Then ApplyPreviewHighlight fnP.Reference, wdYellow: pf = pf + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next fnP" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doEnd Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For Each enP In ActiveDocument.Endnotes" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If InScope(enP.Reference, targetRange) Then ApplyPreviewHighlight enP.Reference, wdYellow: pe = pe + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next enP" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRows As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim keptInline As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If keepText Then keptInline = pf + pe" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set previewRows = NewPreviewSummaryRows()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Footnotes"", pf, False, (Not doFoot)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Endnotes"", pe, False, (Not doEnd)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Note text kept inline"", keptInline, False, (Not keepText)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ShowPreviewActionsSummary Me, ""Footnote / Endnote Remover"", previewRows" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""Footnote / Endnote Remover""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - Footnote / Endnote Remover""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim cntFoot As Long, cntEnd As Long, i As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doFoot Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For i = ActiveDocument.Footnotes.Count To 1 Step -1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim fn As Footnote: Set fn = ActiveDocument.Footnotes(i)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If InScope(fn.Reference, targetRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim footInsertAt As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim footText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                footInsertAt = fn.Reference.Start" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If keepText Then footText = CleanInlineNoteText(fn.Range.Text)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                fn.Delete" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If keepText Then ActiveDocument.Range(footInsertAt, footInsertAt).InsertAfter "" ["" & footText & ""]""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                cntFoot = cntFoot + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doEnd Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        For i = ActiveDocument.Endnotes.Count To 1 Step -1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Dim en As Endnote: Set en = ActiveDocument.Endnotes(i)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            If InScope(en.Reference, targetRange) Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim endInsertAt As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Dim endText As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                endInsertAt = en.Reference.Start" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If keepText Then endText = CleanInlineNoteText(en.Range.Text)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                en.Delete" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If keepText Then ActiveDocument.Range(endInsertAt, endInsertAt).InsertAfter "" ["" & endText & ""]""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                cntEnd = cntEnd + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Next i" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next: undoRec.EndCustomRecord: On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "Private Function CleanInlineNoteText(ByVal noteText As String) As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    noteText = Replace(noteText, vbCr, """")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    noteText = Replace(noteText, Chr$(2), """")" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    CleanInlineNoteText = Trim$(noteText)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmFootnoteRemover_Code = s
End Function

    s = s & "        Dim previewUnlinked As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doClear Then previewCleared = areaCount" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If standardizeFont Then previewFont = areaCount" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If standardizeSpacing Then previewSpacing = areaCount" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If standardizeAlignment Then previewAlignment = areaCount" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If breakLinks Then previewUnlinked = areaCount" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Dim previewRows As Collection" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Set previewRows = NewPreviewSummaryRows()" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Header areas"", headerAreas, False, (Not doHeaders)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Footer areas"", footerAreas, False, (Not doFooters)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Cleared areas"", previewCleared, False, (Not doClear)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Font reset areas"", previewFont, False, (Not standardizeFont)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Spacing reset areas"", previewSpacing, False, (Not standardizeSpacing)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Alignment areas"", previewAlignment, False, (Not standardizeAlignment)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        AddPreviewSummaryRow previewRows, ""Unlinked sections"", previewUnlinked, False, (Not breakLinks)" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ShowPreviewActionsSummary Me, ""Header / Footer Standardizer"", previewRows" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""Header / Footer Standardizer""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - Header / Footer Standardizer""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim cntAreas As Long, cntCleared As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    For Each sec In ActiveDocument.Sections" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doHeaders Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For Each hf In sec.Headers" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ApplyToHF hf, doClear, doFont, doSpacing, doAlign, alignVal, baseName, baseSize, breakLinks, cntAreas, cntCleared" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next hf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        If doFooters Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            For Each hf In sec.Footers" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                ApplyToHF hf, doClear, doFont, doSpacing, doAlign, alignVal, baseName, baseSize, breakLinks, cntAreas, cntCleared" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "            Next hf" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Next sec" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next: undoRec.EndCustomRecord: On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmHeaderFooterStandardizer_Code = s
End Function

    Dim s As String

    s = s & "                c = c + 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                If doDelete Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    ActiveDocument.Shapes(k).Delete" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                Else" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                    ApplyPreviewMinimalMarker ActiveDocument.Shapes(k).Anchor" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "        End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupStart ""Remove Objects""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim undoRec As UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Set undoRec = Application.UndoRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.StartCustomRecord ""Cleanup Suite - Remove Objects""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error GoTo RunErr" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.ScreenUpdating = False" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doPic Then UpdateCleanupProgress ""Removing pictures"": ProcessPictures True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doTxt Then UpdateCleanupProgress ""Removing text boxes"": ProcessTextBoxes True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doFra Then UpdateCleanupProgress ""Removing frames"": ProcessFrames True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doHL Then UpdateCleanupProgress ""Removing horizontal lines"": ProcessHorizontalLines True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doHtml Then UpdateCleanupProgress ""Removing form controls"": ProcessHtmlControls True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doTab Then UpdateCleanupProgress ""Removing tables"": ProcessTables True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    If doHid Then" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        UpdateCleanupProgress ""Removing hidden text""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        ProcessHiddenText True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.ScreenUpdating = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    undoRec.EndCustomRecord" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupToolApplied" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Unload Me" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Exit Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "RunErr:" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrNumber As Long" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim originalErrDescription As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrNumber = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    originalErrDescription = Err.Description" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Application.ScreenUpdating = True" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    On Error Resume Next: undoRec.EndCustomRecord: On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MarkCleanupEnd" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    Dim errMsg As String" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = ""An unexpected error occurred: "" & originalErrNumber & "" - "" & originalErrDescription" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    errMsg = errMsg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Some changes may have been made to the document."" & vbCrLf & _" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "             ""Use Word's Undo command (Ctrl+Z) after closing this message if you want to roll them back.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, ""Cleanup Error""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    s = s & ""
    frmObjectRemover_Code = s
End Function

    Dim s As String

    s = s & "    lblLauncherSubtitle.TextAlign = 1" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    cmdFootnote.Caption = ""Footnote / Endnote""" & vbCrLf

    s = s & "    chkReturnToMainAfterClose.Caption = ""Global default: return to main menu after closing individual tool menus""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    chkReturnToMainAfterClose.Value = GetReturnToMainAfterCloseSetting()" & vbCrLf

' ===========================================================================
' MODULE: modRibbonSetup
' PURPOSE: Writes the CustomUI ribbon XML into the target .dotm / .docm file
'          so that a single "Cleanup Suite" button appears on the Add-ins tab.
'
' HOW TO USE
' ----------
' 1. Run InstallCleanupSuite (above) first so all VBA modules exist.
' 2. Save the document as a Macro-Enabled Template (.dotm) or
'    Macro-Enabled Document (.docm) -- ordinary .docx files cannot hold
'    ribbon XML.
' 3. CLOSE Word completely (the file must not be open while we edit the ZIP).
' 4. Run InjectRibbonXml below from a SEPARATE helper document, passing
'    the full path to your saved .dotm / .docm.
'    e.g.  InjectRibbonXml "C:\Users\You\Documents\CleanupSuite.dotm"
' 5. Re-open the file.  The "Cleanup Suite" button will appear on the
'    Add-ins tab.  Click it once -- Word may ask you to trust the macros.
'
' WHAT THE BUTTON DOES
' --------------------
' It calls ShowCleanupSuiteLauncher, which is already installed by the
' main installer.  The ribbon just gives you a one-click entry point.
'
' RIBBON PLACEMENT
' ----------------
' The XML below places the button in a new group "Cleanup Suite" on the
' built-in Add-ins tab (idMso="TabAddIns").  If you prefer a different
' tab, change the insertAfterMso attribute or wrap in a <tab> element.
' ===========================================================================

' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
' The ribbon XML that will be injected into /customUI/customUI14.xml.
' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Function RIBBON_XML() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "<?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""UTF-8""?>" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "<mso:customUI xmlns:mso=""http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2009/07/customui""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "              onLoad=""RibbonOnLoad"">" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "  <mso:ribbon>" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    <mso:tabs>" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "      <mso:tab idMso=""TabAddIns"">" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        <mso:group id=""grpCleanupSuite""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                   label=""Cleanup Suite""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                   insertAfterMso=""GroupAddInsMenuCommands"">" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "          <mso:button id=""btnCleanupLauncher""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                      label=""Cleanup Suite""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                      screentip=""Open the Professional Cleanup Suite""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                      supertip=""Launches the master cleanup launcher with all of the suite cleanup tools.""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                      imageMso=""ReviewNewComment""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                      onAction=""ShowCleanupSuiteLauncher""" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "                      size=""large""/>" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "        </mso:group>" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "      </mso:tab>" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "    </mso:tabs>" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "  </mso:ribbon>" & vbCrLf
    s = s & "</mso:customUI>"
    RIBBON_XML = s
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Ribbon load callback is installed into modCleanupLauncher by the main
' installer above.  It is NOT declared here to avoid an "Ambiguous name
' detected" compile error caused by having two public RibbonOnLoad subs
' in the same VBA project.
' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
' InjectRibbonXml -- call this ONCE, with the file CLOSED in Word.
'
'   filePath   Full path to the .dotm or .docm file.
'
' The routine:
'   1. Opens the file as a ZIP (Office Open XML is a ZIP archive).
'   2. Adds / replaces the /customUI/customUI14.xml part.
'   3. Adds / updates the [Content_Types].xml entry for the new part.
'   4. Adds / updates the _rels\.rels relationship entry.
'   5. Saves and closes the ZIP.
' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub InjectRibbonXml(filePath As String)
    If Len(filePath) = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Please supply the full path to your .dotm or .docm file.", _
               vbExclamation, "InjectRibbonXml"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim ext As String: ext = LCase$(Right$(filePath, 5))
    If ext <> ".dotm" And ext <> ".docm" Then
        MsgBox "The file must be a .dotm or .docm (macro-enabled format)." & vbCrLf & _
               "Ordinary .docx files cannot contain ribbon XML.", _
               vbExclamation, "InjectRibbonXml"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If Dir(filePath) = "" Then
        MsgBox "File not found:" & vbCrLf & filePath, vbCritical, "InjectRibbonXml"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    On Error GoTo RibbonErr

    Dim fso As Object
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")

    Dim tempRoot As String
    tempRoot = UniqueTempFolder(fso, "CleanupSuiteRibbon")

    Dim bakPath As String
    bakPath = filePath & ".ribbon_backup"

    Dim zipPath As String
    zipPath = filePath & ".ribbon_work.zip"

    If fso.FileExists(bakPath) Then fso.DeleteFile bakPath, True
    If fso.FileExists(zipPath) Then fso.DeleteFile zipPath, True
    EnsureFolder fso, tempRoot
    EnsureFolder fso, tempRoot & "\customUI"

    FileCopy filePath, bakPath
    FileCopy filePath, zipPath

    Dim oShell As Object
    Set oShell = CreateObject("Shell.Application")

    Dim zipNs As Object
    Set zipNs = oShell.NameSpace(zipPath)
    If zipNs Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3101, "InjectRibbonXml", "Could not open the Office file as a ZIP package."

    oShell.NameSpace(tempRoot).CopyHere zipNs.Items, 16
    WaitForShellCopy tempRoot & "\[Content_Types].xml", 15000

    WriteTextFileUtf8 tempRoot & "\customUI\customUI14.xml", RIBBON_XML

    Dim contentTypesPath As String
    contentTypesPath = tempRoot & "\[Content_Types].xml"
    Dim contentTypesXml As String
    contentTypesXml = ReadTextFileUtf8(contentTypesPath)
    contentTypesXml = RemoveXmlElementByAttribute(contentTypesXml, "Override", "PartName", "/customUI/customUI14.xml")
    contentTypesXml = InsertBeforeClosingTag(contentTypesXml, "Types", _
        "  <Override PartName=""/customUI/customUI14.xml"" ContentType=""application/xml""/>" & vbCrLf)
    WriteTextFileUtf8 contentTypesPath, contentTypesXml

    Dim relsPath As String
    relsPath = tempRoot & "\_rels\.rels"
    Dim relsXml As String
    relsXml = ReadTextFileUtf8(relsPath)
    relsXml = RemoveXmlElementByAttribute(relsXml, "Relationship", "Target", "customUI/customUI14.xml")
    relsXml = RemoveXmlElementByAttribute(relsXml, "Relationship", "Target", "/customUI/customUI14.xml")
    relsXml = InsertBeforeClosingTag(relsXml, "Relationships", _
        "  <Relationship Id=""" & NextRelationshipId(relsXml) & """ Type=""http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2007/relationships/ui/extensibility"" Target=""customUI/customUI14.xml""/>" & vbCrLf)
    WriteTextFileUtf8 relsPath, relsXml

    fso.DeleteFile zipPath, True
    CreateEmptyZip zipPath
    Set zipNs = oShell.NameSpace(zipPath)
    If zipNs Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3102, "InjectRibbonXml", "Could not create the replacement ZIP package."

    zipNs.CopyHere fso.GetFolder(tempRoot).Items, 16
    WaitForZipItems zipNs, fso.GetFolder(tempRoot).Files.Count + fso.GetFolder(tempRoot).SubFolders.Count, 20000
    Wait 3000

    fso.DeleteFile filePath, True
    fso.MoveFile zipPath, filePath
    fso.DeleteFolder tempRoot, True

    MsgBox "Ribbon XML was installed successfully." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
           "A backup of the original file was saved as:" & vbCrLf & bakPath & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
           "Re-open the file in Word and use the Cleanup Suite button on the Add-ins tab.", _
           vbInformation, "InjectRibbonXml"
    Exit Sub

RibbonErr:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not fso Is Nothing Then
        If Len(zipPath) > 0 And fso.FileExists(zipPath) Then fso.DeleteFile zipPath, True
        If Len(tempRoot) > 0 And fso.FolderExists(tempRoot) Then fso.DeleteFolder tempRoot, True
        If Len(bakPath) > 0 And fso.FileExists(bakPath) And fso.FileExists(filePath) = False Then
            fso.CopyFile bakPath, filePath, True
        End If
    End If
    MsgBox "Ribbon injection failed." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
           "Error " & Err.Number & ": " & Err.Description & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
           "Your original file was left unchanged or restored from backup.", _
           vbCritical, "InjectRibbonXml"
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Helpers for ZIP rebuilding and package XML patching.
' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub Wait(ms As Long)
    Dim t As Single: t = Timer
    Do While Timer < t + ms / 1000
        DoEvents
    Loop
End Sub

Private Function UniqueTempFolder(fso As Object, prefix As String) As String
    Dim basePath As String
    basePath = Environ$("TEMP")
    If Len(basePath) = 0 Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3106, "InjectRibbonXml", "TEMP environment variable is not set."

    Dim i As Long
    Dim candidate As String
    For i = 1 To 100
        candidate = basePath & "\" & prefix & "_" & Format$(Now, "yyyymmdd_hhnnss") & "_" & CStr(i)
        If Not fso.FolderExists(candidate) And Not fso.FileExists(candidate) Then
            UniqueTempFolder = candidate
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i

    Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3107, "InjectRibbonXml", "Could not allocate a unique temporary folder."
End Function

Private Sub EnsureFolder(fso As Object, folderPath As String)
    If fso.FolderExists(folderPath) Then Exit Sub

    Dim parentPath As String
    parentPath = fso.GetParentFolderName(folderPath)
    If Len(parentPath) > 0 And Not fso.FolderExists(parentPath) Then
        EnsureFolder fso, parentPath
    End If

    On Error GoTo FolderErr
    fso.CreateFolder folderPath
    Exit Sub

FolderErr:
    Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3108, "InjectRibbonXml", _
        "Could not create temporary folder:" & vbCrLf & folderPath & vbCrLf & _
        "Error " & Err.Number & ": " & Err.Description
End Sub

Private Sub WaitForShellCopy(requiredPath As String, timeoutMs As Long)
    Dim waited As Long
    Do While Dir(requiredPath) = "" And waited < timeoutMs
        Wait 200
        waited = waited + 200
    Loop
    If Dir(requiredPath) = "" Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3103, "InjectRibbonXml", "Timed out while unpacking the Office file."
End Sub

Private Sub WaitForZipItems(zipNs As Object, expectedTopLevelItems As Long, timeoutMs As Long)
    Dim waited As Long
    Do While zipNs.Items.Count < expectedTopLevelItems And waited < timeoutMs
        Wait 250
        waited = waited + 250
    Loop
    If zipNs.Items.Count < expectedTopLevelItems Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3104, "InjectRibbonXml", "Timed out while rebuilding the Office file."
End Sub

Private Sub CreateEmptyZip(zipPath As String)
    Dim emptyZip(0 To 21) As Byte
    emptyZip(0) = 80
    emptyZip(1) = 75
    emptyZip(2) = 5
    emptyZip(3) = 6

    Dim ff As Integer
    ff = FreeFile
    Open zipPath For Binary As #ff
    Put #ff, , emptyZip
    Close #ff
End Sub

Private Function ReadTextFileUtf8(filePath As String) As String
    Dim stm As Object
    Set stm = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
    stm.Type = 2
    stm.Charset = "utf-8"
    stm.Open
    stm.LoadFromFile filePath
    ReadTextFileUtf8 = stm.ReadText
    stm.Close
End Function

Private Sub WriteTextFileUtf8(filePath As String, text As String)
    Dim stm As Object
    Set stm = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
    stm.Type = 2
    stm.Charset = "utf-8"
    stm.Open
    stm.WriteText text
    stm.SaveToFile filePath, 2
    stm.Close
End Sub

Private Function InsertBeforeClosingTag(xmlText As String, tagName As String, insertion As String) As String
    Dim closeTag As String
    closeTag = "</" & tagName & ">"

    Dim p As Long
    p = InStrRev(xmlText, closeTag, -1, vbTextCompare)
    If p = 0 Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3105, "InjectRibbonXml", "Could not find closing tag " & closeTag & "."

    InsertBeforeClosingTag = Left$(xmlText, p - 1) & insertion & Mid$(xmlText, p)
End Function

Private Function RemoveXmlElementByAttribute(xmlText As String, elementName As String, attrName As String, attrValue As String) As String
    Dim searchValue As String
    searchValue = attrName & "=""" & attrValue & """"

    Dim p As Long
    p = InStr(1, xmlText, searchValue, vbTextCompare)

    Do While p > 0
        Dim startTag As Long
        startTag = InStrRev(Left$(xmlText, p), "<" & elementName, -1, vbTextCompare)
        If startTag = 0 Then Exit Do

        Dim endTag As Long
        endTag = InStr(p, xmlText, ">")
        If endTag = 0 Then Exit Do

        xmlText = Left$(xmlText, startTag - 1) & Mid$(xmlText, endTag + 1)
        p = InStr(1, xmlText, searchValue, vbTextCompare)
    Loop

    RemoveXmlElementByAttribute = xmlText
End Function

Private Function NextRelationshipId(relsXml As String) As String
    Dim n As Long
    n = 1
    Do While InStr(1, relsXml, "Id=""rIdCleanupSuite" & CStr(n) & """", vbTextCompare) > 0
        n = n + 1
    Loop
    NextRelationshipId = "rIdCleanupSuite" & CStr(n)
End Function

' ---------------------------

' End of ribbon setup module
' ---------------------------
